jobs.title: Assistanat Manager - Research And Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Hiring: Head Chef – Arabian Cuisine & Product Development (R&D)

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ years preferred

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and passionate
**Arabian Cuisine Chef**
, preferably with expertise in traditional Middle Eastern cooking and Arabic bread preparation, to join our team.

This is a specialised culinary development role focused on creating authentic recipes, developing new menu items, standardising food preparation processes and building comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Arabian cuisine, an understanding of traditional cooking techniques and the ability to translate culinary expertise into standardised, repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple restaurant outlets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recipe Development & Menu Innovation**

* Develop authentic Arabian and Middle Eastern recipes.
* Create and refine recipes for Mandi, grilled meats, Alfaham, Shawarma, BBQ, kebabs, marinades, sauces, dips and other Arabian specialities.
* Experiment with ingredients, spices, cooking techniques and flavour profiles.
* Develop new menu items while maintaining authenticity and consistency.
* Conduct food trials, tasting sessions and product evaluations.

**2. Arabic Bread & Bakery Specialisation**

* Develop recipes and preparation methods for traditional Arabic breads.
* Expertise in Khubz, Pita, Saj, Khameer, Tannour and other Middle Eastern breads is highly desirable.
* Standardise dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking temperatures and cooking techniques.
* Establish consistent bread quality, texture, thickness and shelf life.

**3. SOP Development & Standardisation**

* Create detailed recipe documentation with exact ingredient quantities and preparation procedures.
* Develop step-by-step SOPs for food preparation, cooking, storage and handling.
* Establish standard portion sizes, cooking times, temperatures and plating specifications.
* Develop batch preparation methods for commercial kitchen operations.
* Ensure recipes are scalable and consistently reproducible across multiple outlets.

**4. Kitchen Training & Implementation**

* Train kitchen staff on newly developed recipes and preparation techniques.
* Demonstrate standardised cooking procedures.
* Establish quality control and consistency benchmarks.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs within kitchen operations.

**5. Food Costing & Quality Control**

* Assist in ingredient selection and sourcing.
* Develop recipes with commercial viability and cost efficiency in mind.
* Calculate recipe yields, portion costs and wastage.
* Maintain consistency in taste, presentation and product quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of professional culinary experience preferred.
* Strong specialisation in Arabian, Middle Eastern or Gulf cuisine.
* Previous experience working in Gulf countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman or Bahrain) is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in traditional Arabic bread making is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in recipe development and menu creation.
* Ability to document recipes and create structured kitchen SOPs.
* Experience training and managing kitchen teams.
* Good understanding of commercial kitchen operations, food costing and standardisation.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in chefs who understand the difference between simply preparing food and developing a consistent, commercially scalable food product.

The candidate should be passionate about authentic Arabian cuisine, detail-oriented, experimental and capable of building structured culinary systems from the ground up.

**Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on Gulf culinary experience and expertise in both Arabian cuisine and Arabic bread preparation.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume along with details of their culinary specialisation, previous experience and examples of recipes or menus they have developed.

* **We look forward to working with someone who can bring authentic Arabian flavours and professional culinary systems to our growing restaurant business.**

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Foundational AI Research
jobs.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a
**Flex Work**
approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
  
  
At Dolby, we are changing the way the world experiences sight and sound. We enable people to experience music, movies, videos, games, and immersive content in their intended grandeur, making life and work more meaningful, expressive, and engaging. We provide technology to the world’s content creators, owners, and distributors, as well as manufacturers of TVs, mobile devices, PCs, and social and media platforms, so they can truly delight their customers. Dolby is behind many of the sound and imaging experiences people enjoy in movie theaters, living rooms, mobile devices, and online services around the world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are building Foundational AI capabilities that advance how people create, understand, enhance, deliver, and experience media. This work spans foundation models, multimodal AI, generative media, content intelligence, media enhancement, personalization, and applied AI systems that can be reused and adapted across Dolby initiatives.

You will set the technical roadmap for reusable AI capabilities, model assets, training and adaptation methods, evaluation frameworks, and reference implementations that help Dolby teams move from research exploration to practical adoption.

You will work closely with research, product, engineering, platform, legal, privacy, data, and business teams to ensure Dolby’s Foundational AI investments are differentiated, responsibly developed, technically rigorous, and broadly adoptable across the company.
  
  
A major focus of this role is building reusable AI assets and capabilities, including pretrained models, fine-tuning and adaptation recipes, evaluation methodologies, training workflows, model quality benchmarks, and reference implementations. These capabilities will help Dolby teams develop new experiences more efficiently across media understanding, media enhancement, AI-assisted creation, immersive content, personalization, and next-generation entertainment workflows.

* Drive research-to-product transition by moving promising prototypes into validated, reproducible, scalable, and adoptable solutions with clear quality standards, responsible AI practices, and enterprise-ready governance.
* Work closely with platform, MLOps, infrastructure, and data teams to ensure Foundational AI development has the right compute, data pipelines, experiment tracking, artifact management, observability, and deployment paths.
* Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of research scientists while building a culture that balances research creativity, responsible AI practices, and measurable product impact.

**Required Qualifications**
**What You Need to Succeed**

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Reporting to:**
Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Location:**
CC Manufacturing Unit, Bangalore (Onsite)

**Experience:**
6+ years in Quality Assurance / Food Safety, including at least 2 years in a managerial role

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**CTC:**
Up to ₹10 LPA + Benefits

**Role Purpose**

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements.

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch.

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls.
* Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies.
* Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations.
* Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation.

**2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management**

* Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials.
* Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters.
* Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance.
* Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials.

**3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance**

* Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing.
* Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging.
* Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records.
* Monitor and validate critical process parameters including time, temperature, moisture, water activity, product weight and packaging integrity.
* Establish preventive controls against cross-contamination, foreign-body contamination and process deviations.
* Lead investigations into manufacturing non-conformities and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Work with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce rejection and achieve First Time Right production.

**4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation**

* Take overall responsibility for factory hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards.
* Establish and monitor personnel hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and environmental monitoring programmes.
* Ensure effective hygiene zoning and segregation of raw, semi-processed and finished products.
* Oversee cleaning verification, ATP testing, environmental swabbing and microbiological monitoring.
* Monitor pest control, waste handling, water quality and other environmental conditions affecting food safety.
* Lead food safety risk assessments and ensure timely mitigation of identified hazards.
* Conduct periodic GMP and hygiene audits across production, storage and utility areas.

**5. Finished Product Quality & Batch Release**

* Own finished product quality standards and release procedures.
* Ensure appropriate physical, chemical, microbiological and sensory testing before product release.
* Establish product specifications for nutritional composition, moisture, water activity, packaging integrity, net weight, appearance and shelf life.
* Review batch manufacturing records, process deviations and quality testing results.
* Exercise authority to approve, hold, reject or release finished product batches based on defined quality and food safety criteria.
* Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, retention samples and product stability studies.
* Oversee packaging quality, seal integrity, batch coding, labelling and traceability compliance.

6. Laboratory & Quality Testing Management

* Manage internal quality laboratories and coordinate testing with approved external laboratories.
* Establish testing plans for raw materials, in-process samples, environmental samples and finished products.
* Oversee microbiological, chemical, physical and nutritional quality testing.
* Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance, method verification and testing accuracy.
* Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions.
* Establish laboratory testing budgets, consumable requirements and equipment procurement plans.
* Work closely with R&D on formulation validation, shelf-life studies and new product development.

**7. Quality Documentation, Traceability & CAPA**

* Establish and maintain robust documentation and record-control systems.
* Ensure end-to-end batch traceability from raw material receipt through manufacturing and dispatch.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product defects, contamination risks and quality failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Establish product withdrawal and recall procedures and conduct periodic mock recall exercises.

jobs.title: Head - Voice of Customer
jobs.description:
At Swish, we want to build a strong understanding of what customers want, what they love, and what makes them unhappy — and use that understanding to continuously improve the food and experience we offer.

We are looking for a Head – Voice of Customer to build this function from the ground up.

You will own Swish's Voice of Customer program end-to-end — from understanding what customers want before we launch a product, to capturing feedback after launch, identifying recurring problems, and working with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to fix them.

**What You Will Own**

**Build Swish's Voice of Customer Engine**

Design and run an always-on customer feedback system across the customer journey, covering pre-launch research, new product feedback, negative-rating triage, customer immersions, interviews, targeted outreach and surprise audits. Decide what we need to learn, from whom, how frequently and through which channel, using the right mix of qualitative and quantitative research.

**Turn Feedback Into Action**

Go beyond collecting feedback to identify the actual problem, understand its root cause and determine whether it is a one-off, product or category-level issue. Work closely with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to turn customer feedback → root cause → action → measurable improvement. The role will be measured on issues resolved and outcomes improved, not the number of calls or insights generated.

**Prioritise Research & Drive Decisions**

Build the framework to determine which categories and SKUs need deeper research, when to trigger audits, when patterns need escalation and where the VoC team's time and resources should be invested. Bring customer evidence into decisions around new launches, recipe changes, relaunches, taste, quality, portioning, pricing, packaging and assortment.

**Build & Lead the VoC Team**

Hire, coach and manage the initial VoC team, set clear goals and operating cadences, and build strong capabilities in customer conversations, probing, research and root-cause identification. Create a team that is accountable for outcomes rather than activity.

**Continuously Improve the System**

Own and improve the questionnaires, interview frameworks, sampling, feedback channels, tracking, reporting, escalation mechanisms and research methodology as the business grows.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of overall experience, with 3–4+ years of people management experience.
* Experience building and running customer research, insights or CX programs in-house, rather than only managing external agencies.
* Experience in consumer internet, food-tech, FMCG or another high-frequency consumer business.
* Experience running customer research or feedback programs at operational scale — not just occasional market research projects.
* Someone who has owned a business/customer metric end-to-end, rather than only producing reports or insights for another team.
* Experience working closely with Operations, Category/Product, Quality and other cross-functional teams to drive changes based on customer feedback.

**We Particularly Value**

* Someone who has built a function from scratch — team, processes, tools and operating cadence.
* Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research.
* Strong understanding of customer interviews, surveys, ratings/reviews and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience managing calling or field teams and understanding operational metrics such as connect rates, response rates, call fatigue and script adherence.
* Experience in food, FMCG, QSR or other categories where taste, freshness, quality, portioning and value directly influence customer satisfaction.

**What Good Looks Like**

**In the first 6–12 months, you should have:**

* Built a functioning VoC team and operating cadence.
* Created a reliable system to capture and prioritise customer feedback.
* Established clear feedback loops across categories and products.
* Identified recurring customer problems and driven them to resolution.
* Built a strong mechanism for feeding customer insights into launches, product changes and category decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvement in relevant customer metrics such as ratings, complaints, repeat issues or product-level satisfaction.

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We re looking for an AI Product Engineer who builds with AI by default and cares deeply about the product. You ll partner closely with our CEO to shape and move Audrey forward. You ll turn ideas into clear decisions, then build them end to end alongside a small, collaborative engineering team.

This role suits someone who leads through clarity and trust, brings people with them, and helps the whole team do its best work.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with the CEO on product direction: shape priorities, test assumptions, and turn ideas into clear, buildable plans.
* Design and build AI features end to end, including prompts and agents, retrieval, and the experience around them.
* Put evaluation and testing in place so AI quality is measurable and keeps improving.
* Ship full-stack features across front end, back end and cloud deployment.
* Work hand in hand with fellow engineers: share context, pair on problems, and help everyone get more from AI tools.
* Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs early and clearly.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

* First 30 days:  learn the product, the teachers who use it and the team; get hands-on and ship a first improvement.
* By 60 days:  own a meaningful part of the AI experience and deliver improvements on agreed timelines.
* By 90 days:  help shape the next phase of the product roadmap with the CEO.

What We re Looking For

* 5-8 years of full-stack software engineering: React/TypeScript front end; Node.js or Python back end; AWS.
* You ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM application used by real users. What you ve built matters more to us than years on a r sum .
* Hands-on experience with prompt and agent design, RAG (embeddings, vector search, re-ranking), and evaluating LLM output quality.
* An AI-native way of working: you use AI tools every day and can show the speed it gives you.
* Leadership capability: you ve owned a product area or driven product decisions, and you influence through ideas, trust and collaboration.
* A genuine product mindset: you re curious about the teachers who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.

jobs.title: VP R&D Injectable Products
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Off Targets Research is building a pipeline of differentiated, complex injectable products for regulated markets, developed through the 505(b)(2) and complex-generic routes and out-licensed to commercial partners. The Vice President R&D, Formulation Development (Injectables) will own formulation and process development end to end, from product feasibility to technology transfer and regulatory submission.

This is an executive role. You will set the technical strategy for the function, decide which products and formulation approaches the company pursues, hold the function accountable for timelines, quality and regulatory success, and represent Off Targets technically with partners, CDMOs and regulators. You will remain close to the science and will lead from technical depth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and portfolio**

* Define the formulation development strategy for the complex injectable portfolio, including suspensions and nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal and lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, ready-to-use solutions and depot / long-acting injectables.
* Assess the technical feasibility, risk and commercial attractiveness of new product opportunities, and advise the CEO and Board on which to pursue, delay or drop.
* Design formulation approaches that are patent-aware and non-infringing, working with IP counsel on freedom-to-operate and carve-out strategy.
* Own the development plan, milestones and budget for the function, and report progress and risks to the CEO and Board.

**Technical leadership and execution**

* Lead preformulation, prototype development, optimisation, scale-up and exhibit batch execution for assigned programmes, either directly or through senior scientists.
* Apply QbD and risk-based approaches (CQAs, CPPs, DoE, control strategy) to formulation design, process understanding and troubleshooting.
* Resolve the hardest formulation and process problems, including stability failures, particle size and polymorph control, precipitation, injectability, reconstitution behaviour and process robustness.
* Make sound sterilisation and manufacturing-route decisions (aseptic, terminal, filtration, lyophilisation, container closure) and understand their effect on product quality and regulatory risk.
* Oversee technology transfer to pilot and commercial manufacturing sites and CDMOs, and challenge their execution where needed.

**Regulatory, quality and CMC**

* Own the formulation and process development sections of regulatory filings (including 3.2.P.2) and the scientific justification behind them, and lead responses to regulatory queries.
* Work with Analytical R&D, QA and Regulatory Affairs to align methods, specifications, characterisation, in-vitro performance testing and stability programmes.
* Set and uphold standards for documentation, data integrity, laboratory discipline and technical review across the function.

**Commercial and partner engagement**

* Lead the technical side of out-licensing, co-development and contract development discussions, including due diligence responses and partner presentations.
* Build and maintain relationships with CDMOs, CROs, technology providers and external experts.

**People and capability**

* Build, lead and mentor the formulation team, including senior scientists and managers, and develop the next level of leaders.
* Set the culture of the function: scientific rigour, accountability, speed and a bias for solving problems at the root.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Ph.D. in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline (strongly preferred), or M.Pharm / M.S. with an exceptional track record.

**Experience (must have)**

* 25 or more years in pharmaceutical R&D, with at least 20 years in injectable or sterile product development.
* A record of taking injectable products through to regulatory submission and approval in the US, preferably through 505(b)(2) or complex-generic routes.
* Hands-on depth in at least two complex dosage forms from: suspensions or nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal or lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, depot or long-acting injectables.
* Proven experience in scale-up and technology transfer to manufacturing sites or CDMOs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in specialty pharma, complex-generic or injectable CDMO environments.
* Familiarity with patent landscapes and non-infringing formulation design.
* Exposure to licensing, partnering or technical due diligence.
* Experience working with regulators, including FDA meetings and deficiency responses.

**Leadership attributes**

* Technical authority that earns the respect of scientists and partners.
* Strong judgement under uncertainty, and the courage to give the CEO and Board a straight view.
* Clear written and spoken communication with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* High ownership, urgency and accountability for delivery.

**Why Join Off Targets**

* A senior role with direct access to the Chairman and CEO and real influence on which products the company develops.
* A pipeline of differentiated injectable products with commercial relevance, built for out-licensing to partners.
* Scientific rigour paired with speed and accountability, in a company small enough for a leader to shape how things are done.
* Competitive fixed compensation, together with a performance-linked incentive tied to out-licensing outcomes.

**How to Apply**

Send your CV to the contact provided with this description. All discussions are treated in confidence.

jobs.title: AM - Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To lead and manage the complete Quality Assurance and Quality Control function of a high-precision aerospace CNC manufacturing facility, ensuring compliance with AS9100D Rev. D, ISO 9001:2015, aerospace customer requirements, engineering drawings and applicable industry standards.

The candidate must possess strong practical experience in aerospace quality management systems, APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, Gauge R&R, CMM inspection, GD&T, AS9102 First Article Inspection, special process control and aerospace customer quality management.

The individual should be capable of independently handling customer quality audits, technical discussions, quality escalations and approval requirements.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Aerospace Quality Management System AS9100D Rev. D**

* Establish, implement, maintain and continuously improve AS9100D Rev. D Quality Management System.
* Ensure effective implementation of ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain Quality Manual, procedures, work instructions and quality records.
* Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits.
* Coordinate external certification audits, surveillance audits and customer audits.
* Manage NCR, CAPA, corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure risk-based thinking, operational risk management and continual improvement.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace customer-specific quality requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of the Quality Management System.

**B. APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning**

* Lead APQP activities for new aerospace product development.
* Prepare and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* Prepare and implement Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
* Develop and implement Control Plans.
* Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* Establish quality planning and inspection requirements for new components.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering for process validation.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality planning during NPI.
* Review and approve quality documentation before production release.

**C. MSA – Measurement System Analysis and Gauge R&R**

* Strong practical knowledge of Measurement System Analysis (MSA).
* Conduct and review Gauge R&R studies covering repeatability and reproducibility.
* Evaluate measurement system capability and suitability.
* Establish calibration and verification systems for measuring instruments.
* Understand measurement uncertainty, accuracy, precision and traceability.
* Ensure appropriate measuring instruments are selected for critical aerospace dimensions.
* Maintain calibration records and measuring instrument registers.
* Establish measurement system control for CMM and other precision inspection equipment.

**D. Dimensional Inspection and Advanced Metrology**

Must have strong practical knowledge of:

* CMM operation, programming and inspection methodology.
* Contour measuring instruments.
* Profile projectors.
* Height gauges, bore gauges and precision micrometers.
* Roundness and surface roughness measuring instruments.
* Digital and specialised precision measuring equipment.
* Calibration and measurement traceability.
* GD&T and complex engineering drawing interpretation.
* Datum structures, true position, profile, concentricity, runout and geometric tolerances.

Ensure inspection planning, first-off inspection, in-process inspection and final inspection of aerospace components.

**E. CNC Machining Quality and Process Inspection**

Experience in quality control and inspection of:

* CNC turning components.
* Twin-spindle CNC turn-mill components.
* 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milled components.
* CNC VTL components.
* Wire-Cut EDM components.
* Complex precision aerospace components with tight dimensional tolerances.

Ensure dimensional inspection reports are reviewed against customer drawings, specifications and approved inspection requirements.

**F. Aerospace Special Process Quality Management**

* Strong understanding of aerospace special process requirements.
* Control and monitor in-house and outsourced special processes.
* Experience with heat treatment, anodising, chemical conversion coating, plating, passivation and protective coatings.
* Knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) processes such as FPI, MPI, UT and radiography.
* Review special process certificates, test reports and process qualification records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace specifications and customer requirements.
* Coordinate special process supplier audits and approval requirements.
* Knowledge of NADCAP accreditation and special process supplier management will be a strong advantage.

**G. Aerospace Quality Documentation and First Article Inspection**

* Preparation and review of AS9102 First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR).
* Preparation and maintenance of APQP documentation.
* Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* PFMEA and Control Plans.
* Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* MSA and Gauge R&R reports.
* Dimensional inspection and CMM reports.
* Material traceability records and material test certificates.
* Special process certificates and qualification records.
* Non-Conformance Reports (NCR).
* Corrective Action Reports (CAR) and 8D reports.
* Calibration and measurement system records.
* Customer-specific quality documentation and approval records.

**H. Quality Tools and Continuous Improvement**

* Strong knowledge of 7 QC Tools.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Process Capability Analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp and Ppk).
* Root Cause Analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone.
* 8D Problem Solving.
* Risk Management and FMEA.
* Continuous improvement and defect prevention.
* Supplier Quality Management and supplier development.
* Reduction of internal and customer rejection.

**I. Supplier Quality Management**

* Monitor and improve supplier quality performance.
* Conduct supplier quality audits and process evaluations.
* Ensure raw material certifications and material traceability.
* Monitor outsourced special process suppliers.
* Handle supplier non-conformities and corrective actions.
* Ensure supplier compliance with aerospace customer requirements.
* Maintain approved supplier documentation and performance records.

**J. Aerospace Customer Handling and Quality Management**

* Strong experience in direct customer quality interactions with aerospace OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers.
* Independently handle customer quality audits, quality reviews and technical discussions.
* Handle customer complaints, NCRs, corrective actions and 8D reports.
* Coordinate customer FAI approvals and dimensional inspection documentation.
* Respond to customer queries related to GD&T, CMM, MSA, Gauge R&R, material traceability and special processes.
* Manage customer quality escalations and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Coordinate customer visits and represent the organisation during quality meetings.
* Ensure customer-specific quality requirements are understood and implemented across departments.

**Preferred Aerospace Customer Exposure:**

Airbus, Boeing, Honeywell Aerospace, GE Aerospace, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney, ISRO and HAL.

Experience working with their approved Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers will also be considered.

**K. Quality Team Management and Training**

* Lead and manage quality engineers, inspectors, CMM programmers and metrology personnel.
* Develop departmental responsibilities and competency matrices.
* Conduct training on AS9100D, GD&T, CMM, APQP, PFMEA, MSA and inspection methods.
* Develop employee technical competency and inspection skills.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality procedures across production and engineering.

jobs.title: PR&D - Advisor/Architect - Data & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**    

Product Research Development (PRD) owns the CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) data that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across Lilly's development portfolio, spanning structured systems (LIMS, MES, DMS, ELN) and unstructured scientific content (protocols, batch records, investigation reports). The function operates under strict GxP, data integrity, and audit-readiness requirements. The Advisor/Architect - Data Agentic AI, PRD, builds the engineering backbone that carries PRD content from source to a governed, served agent: ingestion pipelines, ML and NLP components, retrieval services, APIs, and agent runtimes that sit on the Semantic Layer and Knowledge Graph. This role is hands-on, writing and shipping production code across data engineering, ML, and agentic delivery, and equally operates at design and guidance level: setting reference designs, reviewing team designs, and advising the teams that build on the platform. It works alongside the Systems Architect and knowledge graph engineers who own ontology and graph design. This role ensures PRD's agents are built on shared, tested, reusable components rather than one-off pipelines, so each new agent and domain ships faster and stays governable as the footprint scales.

  
   
  **Path/Level**    

**Path/Level: R4/R5 (Advisor/Architect), individual contributor.**

  
   
  **Key Responsibilities**    

* Multi-Modal Data Ingestion - build and operate ingestion pipelines for multi-modal and multi-lingual PRD content (documents, structured records, and beyond text-only formats where relevant), feeding the knowledge graph and vector store with ontology-based tagging.
* ML NLP Components - build entity and relationship extraction, classification, embedding, and LLM-assisted metadata enrichment components, and productionize them with testing, versioning, and monitoring.
* Retrieval Services - implement and tune hybrid graph, vector, and keyword retrieval services for human exploration and agentic tool calls, optimizing precision, recall, latency, and groundedness against agreed evaluation sets.
* Agent Runtimes MCP Services - build agent runtimes and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose Semantic Layer capabilities (QA, summarization, context retrieval) with tool calling, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.

**What is the opportunity**

  
Required Skills

* 6 to 12 years in product security, PSIRT, vulnerability response, or security incident response, including coordination of multi-team remediation under time pressure.
* Hands-on experience running or coordinating security incidents and vulnerability disclosures end to end.
* Working knowledge of CVSS, CWE, CVE/CNA processes, VEX, SBOM, and ISO/IEC 29147 and 30111 concepts.

* Self-motivated and effective across functional teams.
* Bachelors degree in computer science, information systems, risk management, or a similar field strongly preferred .

The Work: What type of work will you be doing   
1. Vulnerability response and incident coordination   

* Own end-to-end coordination of externally reported and actively exploited product vulnerabilities, from intake and triage through remediation, coordinated disclosure, and customer communication, for on-premises and SaaS products.
* Act as incident coordinator for high-severity product security events: set severity, run the bridge, assign owners, track timelines, and drive decisions with Engineering, Product, Support, Legal, and Communications.
* Coordinate security engineers and external stakeholders (researchers, CERTs, vendors, customers, coordinators) to remediate high-profile vulnerabilities within tight timeframes.
* Run coordinated disclosure, including embargo management, CVE assignment, advisory publication, and researcher relations.
* Perform RCCA and post-incident reviews, and present findings and trends to executive staff.

  
2. AI-driven vulnerability operations   

* Design, deploy, and govern AI-assisted workflows for intake deduplication, triage, exploitability and impact analysis, severity scoring, and advisory drafting, with human review at decision points.
* Evaluate and operationalize AI-enabled tooling and automation to raise speed and scale while managing accuracy, hallucination, data handling, and tenant-isolation risks.
* Triage and respond to the rising volume of AI-generated vulnerability reports, including low-quality submissions, and to AI-accelerated exploitation that shortens the time from disclosure to attack.

3. Program and process

* Define and report program roadmap, status, and success metrics (SLAs, backlog, aging, disclosure timelines).
* Support regulatory and customer obligations tied to vulnerability handling and disclosure (for example EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting, CNA responsibilities, customer and audit inquiries).
* Answer customer and field "am I impacted by CVE X" inquiries using SBOM, scanner, and threat intelligence data.
* Monitor threat intelligence, exploit activity, and KEV-class signals to maintain situational awareness and drive prioritization.
* Engage the security community: researchers, bug bounty participants, vendors, and conferences.
* Work with stakeholders from engineering to executive level.

Preferred Skills   

* Prior software engineering or architecture experience, including secure coding practices.
* Scripting or automation skills (Python, APIs, Jira/Confluence automation) to build workflows.
* Experience with SAST, SCA, and vulnerability scanners, and code platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).

jobs.description:

Scimplify is a specialty chemicals company that connects global brands with a network of 500+ manufacturing partners, serving 1,000+ customers across 30+ countries. We are building a new business vertical in Natural Caffeine focused on anhydrous caffeine derived from coffee, tea, and other botanical sources. Production is based on by-product and crude caffeine streams rather than direct tea or coffee procurement.

Role Overview

The Business Head will own the  **Natural Caffeine**  vertical end-to-end, including strategy, sourcing, manufacturing partnerships, customer development, and complete P&L responsibility.

The focus will be to take the business from commercial thesis and pilot-scale operations to first commercial shipments and eventually a scaled, profitable global business.

Scimplify follows an asset-light operating model. Feedstocks such as decaffeination residue, crude caffeine, coffee pulp, and tea waste are sourced from external processors, while extraction, purification, and standardization are executed through third-party manufacturing partners under Scimplifys commercial and quality oversight.

The successful candidate will ensure this model operates efficiently, profitably, and reliably.

P&L Ownership

- Revenue

Industry Representation

Governance & Compliance

Requirements

Why Join Scimplify

+ Years (hardware/firmware/signal acquisition validation, not research-only)

**1. Job Title**

Senior EEG Hardware Design & Integration Engineer

**Company Description:**

Basil Health AI is developing neuro-wellness technology that integrates ancient wisdom, modern neuroscience, and AI-driven personalization to help individuals better understand and improve their mental well-being. The company focuses on making mental wellness measurable, personalized, and actionable through evidence-based mental optimization tools. Basil Health AI is also innovating a Web3-enabled engagement layer that uses a utility token to reward real mental progress and support community-driven growth. Its technology has been tested with major organizations and is supported by researchers from leading institutions, including IIT Kanpur, IIT Mandi, the University of Maryland, and Michigan State University. Basil Health AI collaborates globally with corporates, healthcare providers, research institutions, wellness retreats, and NGOs to advance mental wellness and cognitive health.

We are hiring a hands-on engineer to independently evaluate, validate, and troubleshoot EEG acquisition systems — both commercial devices and custom-built hardware. This is an engineering and quality-validation role centered on the full EEG acquisition chain: electrodes, analog front end, ADC, firmware, embedded data pipeline, wireless streaming, and signal integrity at the hardware level.

This role is explicitly NOT a neuroscience research or EEG machine-learning position. Instead, the focus is on whether a device is built and behaving correctly: is the analog design sound, is the firmware acquiring data faithfully, is the signal clean enough to trust, and — when it isn't — is the root cause hardware, firmware, electrode/placement, physiological, or environmental.

The ideal candidate can take a newly purchased or newly built EEG system, inspect its datasheets and raw output, run a structured validation protocol, and issue a clear engineering verdict: approve for use, flag specific defects, or recommend redesign.

**2. Role Summary**

We are hiring a hands-on engineer with strong experience in
**EEG hardware design, signal acquisition, analog electronics, electrode integration, and PCB-level hardware development**
.

The role focuses on designing and integrating reliable electrical connections between EEG electrodes, PPG sensors, and electronics modules while ensuring low-noise, high-quality physiological signal acquisition.

A key responsibility is investigating and developing detachable hardware connection mechanisms, particularly pogo-pin connectors with magnetic attachment, while also evaluating other approaches such as direct soldering and USB-C connections.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently designing, prototyping, troubleshooting, and validating EEG hardware interfaces without compromising signal quality.

**Prior practical experience with EEG acquisition hardware is strictly mandatory.**
This is not a firmware development, neuroscience research, or EEG AI/ML role.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

* Design and integrate EEG electrodes and PPG sensors with acquisition electronics.
* Develop reliable EEG signal, reference, and ground/bias connections.
* Investigate electrical connection mechanisms, including soldering, USB-C, and pogo-pin connectors.
* Design and evaluate pogo-pin-based interfaces with magnetic attachment for detachable electronics modules.
* Define connector pin assignments, PCB contact pads, power connections, and signal routing.
* Ensure reliable electrical contact, mechanical alignment, and durability during repeated attachment and detachment.
* Design, review, and modify EEG circuit schematics and PCB layouts.
* Evaluate EEG analog front-end performance, including amplification, input impedance, CMRR, filtering, and ADC characteristics.
* Identify and minimize electrical noise, grounding issues, signal interference, and electrode-contact instability.
* Ensure PPG sensor integration does not interfere with sensitive EEG acquisition.
* Validate EEG signal quality, connector reliability, electrical continuity, and mechanical stability.
* Diagnose hardware-related signal-quality problems and recommend design improvements.
* Document hardware designs, testing results, and validation findings.

**4. Required Technical Skills**

* **Proven hands-on EEG hardware design, development, integration, or troubleshooting experience is mandatory.**
* Strong understanding of EEG hardware architecture: electrodes → analog front end → ADC → acquisition electronics.
* Practical knowledge of wet/dry EEG electrodes, electrode impedance, and reference/ground/bias configurations.
* Experience with low-noise analog electronics, instrumentation amplifiers, gain, CMRR, input impedance, and bandwidth.
* Understanding of EEG analog front-end ICs.
* Knowledge of ADC resolution, dynamic range, sampling rates, and analog filtering.
* Experience integrating biomedical sensors, including EEG electrodes and familiarity with PPG sensor interfaces.
* Practical knowledge of PCB design, schematic review, grounding, shielding, and signal routing.
* Understanding of electrical connectors, including pogo pins, contact pads, board-to-board connectors, and USB-C.
* Knowledge of connector alignment, contact resistance, pin assignments, and mechanical reliability.
* Ability to diagnose EEG signal noise, baseline drift, electrode-contact problems, and electrical interference.
* Ability to use oscilloscopes, signal generators, multimeters, and other electronic test equipment.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Prior experience developing or integrating wearable EEG headsets or acquisition devices.
* Experience designing multichannel EEG acquisition circuits.
* Practical experience with pogo-pin connectors, magnetic attachments, or detachable electronic modules.
* Experience integrating EEG and PPG sensors in wearable hardware.
* Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, or Eagle.
* Experience working with EEG hardware vendors or hardware prototyping teams.

**6. Practical Hands-on Experience Expected**

* Has physically worked with EEG electrodes, analog front ends, and EEG acquisition circuits.
* Has successfully acquired raw EEG signals and troubleshot hardware-level signal-quality issues.
* Has integrated EEG electrodes with acquisition electronics.
* Has worked on low-noise analog circuitry, grounding, shielding, and electrical interfaces.
* Has designed, reviewed, or modified PCB schematics and layouts.
* Has experience with electrical connectors, hardware interfaces, or sensor integration.
* Has used bench equipment to evaluate electrical signals and hardware performance.
* Can independently prototype and validate a detachable electrical connection mechanism.
* Has investigated and resolved hardware-related electrical noise or contact issues.

**7. Tools, Platforms, and Hardware Experience**

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. **Your Role at Baxter**
Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories.
  
  
This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care.
  
  
**What you'll be doing**

* Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements.
* Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1.
* Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17.
* Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions.
* Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18.
* Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems.
* Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562.
* Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices.
* Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective.
* Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings.
* Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements.
* Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions.
* Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance.

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry.
* Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards.
* Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562.
* Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions.
* Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments.
* Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971.
* Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies.
* Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays.
* Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes.
* Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines.
* Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment.

jobs.title: Optical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Optical Engineer with a proven track record in developing advanced ophthalmic imaging systems, including Scanning Laser Ophthalmoscopy (SLO), Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), hyperspectral imaging, and hybrid/multimodal platforms.

This role will lead optical system architecture from concept to clinical-grade implementation, integrating diverse imaging modalities into compact, manufacturable platforms suitable for real-world ophthalmic workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

**System Architecture & Design**

* Architect optical systems integrating multiple imaging modalities such as:

SLO + OCT

SLO + Hyperspectral

OCT + Fundus

* Full multimodal retinal platforms (structural + functional imaging)
* Design beam paths, scanner modules, fiber-optic interferometers, dispersion compensation, spectral splitting/combiners and illumination subsystems.
* Model and simulate optical design parameters including PSF, aberrations, spectral response, and system tolerances using Zemax, CodeV, or equivalent.

**Hyperspectral & Multispectral Development**

* Engineer narrowband and broadband illumination systems leveraging AOTFs, LCTFs, swept-wavelength excitation, or LED/laser spectral arrays.
* Develop optical systems optimized for spectral sensitivity, spectral registration accuracy, and illumination safety for ocular tissue.
* Work with software/imaging teams to define calibration matrices, spectral unmixing, reflectance normalization, and spectral correction for ocular media.

**Prototype Engineering & Experimental Validation**

* Build and iterate bench prototypes integrating galvanometers or MEMS scanners, tunable source engines, deformable mirrors (if applicable), and sensitive detection pathways (APD, SiPM, InGaAs cameras).
* Define and execute precision alignment workflows, optical calibration, and imaging performance characterisation.
* Evaluate SNR, sensitivity roll-off, axial/lateral resolution, chromatic artifacts, and spectral fidelity.

**Systems Integration & Productization**

* Collaborate with electronics, embedded software, computational imaging, and clinical engineering teams to ensure robust platform integration.
* Support manufacturability refinement, component supplier analysis, and optical assembly workflows for scale-up.

**Regulatory & Documentation**

Produce detailed design files, tolerance analysis, optical safety documentation, calibration protocols, and verification reports aligned with:

* ISO 15004-2
* IEC 60825-1 (laser safety)
* IEC 60601 series
* ISO 13485-controlled product development

**Key Expertise & Experience**

* Proven design experience in OCT (SD-OCT or SS-OCT) and/or SLO retinal imaging systems.
* Hands-on experience with multimodal imaging system development (hardware + calibration).
* High proficiency in optical simulation and design tools such as Zemax, CodeV, LightTools, FRED.
* Deep understanding of:
* Fiber optic interferometry
* Spectral illumination systems
* Polarization optics
* Laser safety and retinal exposure limits
* Track record of hardware debugging, hands-on alignment, prototyping, and experimental troubleshooting.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with adaptive optics retinal imaging.
* Knowledge of GPU/FPGA accelerated imaging pipelines and OCT reconstruction.
* Prior work in medical imaging device regulatory pathways, including clinical testing and design transfer.

**Qualifications**

* Should have put products out in Ophthalmic Sciences.
* Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD in Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or equivalent.
* Patent, thesis, or publication history in OCT/SLO/hyperspectral or retinal imaging preferred.

**What You’ll Deliver in the First 12–18 Months**

* A fully validated multimodal ophthalmic imaging prototype demonstrating superior image quality and clinical-grade repeatability.
* Transferable and manufacturable optical design with IP supporting strategic defensibility.
* Contribution to imaging roadmap, including next-generation spectral and structural modalities.

jobs.title: PR&D – Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**PR&D – Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC**
Product Research & Development (PR&D)
  
  

* CTI-MD Tech@Lilly

Product Research & Development (PR&D) owns the CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) data that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across Lilly's development portfolio. That data is created and held in lab and plant systems: LIMS, ELN, chromatography and instrument software, lab-data platforms, MES, DMS, and related tools, operating under strict GxP, data integrity, and audit-readiness requirements. The Senior Scientific Systems & Integration Engineer, PR&D/CMC, implements, configures, and integrates those systems and owns the workflow automation that connects them across PR&D labs. The primary expertise for this role is PR&D and CMC process and tools knowledge, delivery in a GxP environment, and hands-on LIMS platform implementation and integration. The secondary expertise is agentic AI: building the MCP tools, agent hooks, and evaluation sets that let PR&D's agents act on these systems safely. The role is hands-on and implementation-heavy, and matures into a systems architect who owns the connected lab-to-plant landscape. This role ensures integrations, workflow configurations, and tool definitions are built once as PR&D-owned, reusable assets that every later lab domain and agent use case builds on.
  
  
**Path/Level: R4/R5 (Senior Principal Engineer), individual contributor.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* LIMS Implementation & Configuration — implement and configure LIMS and scientific workflow platforms for PR&D and CMC use: sample lifecycle, test execution, specifications, review and release, investigations, and stability, to GxP standards.
* Lab & Plant Integration Ownership — own integrations between lab systems (LIMS, ELN, chromatography data systems, instruments, instrument middleware, lab-data platforms) and plant-side systems (MES, historians, QMS, DMS), including interface design, error handling, and support.
* Instrument & Lab-Data Platform Integration — build and maintain instrument connectivity and data flows into lab-data platforms such as TetraScience, including ingestion, data harmonization, and use of connectivity standards (for example Allotrope, SiLA, OPC UA) where applicable.
* Scientific Workflow Automation — design and automate cross-system scientific workflows, replacing manual hand-offs and re-keying with governed, auditable flows.
* PR&D/CMC Data Mapping — with the Systems Architect and knowledge graph engineers, map LIMS, ELN, and lab-data entities (samples, batches, specifications, process parameters, investigations) to the Semantic Layer, keeping source semantics intact.
* Agentic Enablement — build MCP tools and workflow hooks so agents can read from and act on LIMS and lab systems within defined permissions, support agent-to-agent hand-offs with the knowledge agents, and assemble evaluation sets from real lab and CMC questions.
* GxP Validation & Compliance — deliver to GAMP 5-aligned validation expectations; produce requirements traceability, test evidence, and change-control documentation; and ensure data integrity (ALCOA+), audit trails, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliance across implementations and integrations.
* Cross-Lab Scope — deliver across PR&D labs, aligning configurations and integration patterns so the same capability does not get rebuilt per lab or system.
* Vendor & Partner Delivery Governance — direct and technically review partner and vendor work on instrument integration and platform configuration, holding partners to PR&D-owned standards and designs.
* Reusable Integration Patterns — establish reference integrations, workflow templates, and configuration standards that accelerate delivery for later lab and plant domains.
* Stakeholder Partnership & Mentorship — work directly with scientists, QA, and lab and plant system owners to shape requirements and priorities; mentor engineers on LIMS, integration, and GxP delivery practice.

**Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas**
LIMS Implementation & Configuration
  
  

* ELN Integration
* Chromatography Data Systems & Instrument Integration
* Instrument Middleware
* Lab-Data Platforms (TetraScience or equivalent)
* Connectivity Standards (Allotrope, SiLA 2, OPC UA, MQTT)
* MES, Historian, QMS & DMS Integration
* API & Integration Architecture (REST, middleware, event-driven)
* Scientific Workflow Automation
* PR&D/CMC Process Knowledge (batch records, process parameters, QC and stability data)
* GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+
* Computer System Validation
* Data Mapping to Ontologies & Semantic Layer
* Agentic AI & MCP
* Agent Evaluation Basics
* Python
* SQL
* Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS)
* Vendor & Delivery Governance
* Stakeholder Management

**Basic Qualifications**

* Proven track record implementing and integrating LIMS or equivalent scientific workflow platforms in a GxP-regulated environment, building and configuring them rather than overseeing a vendor.
* Working knowledge of PR&D or CMC processes and the tools around them (LIMS, ELN, chromatography and instrument software, lab-data platforms, MES, DMS).
* Hands-on experience integrating lab systems with each other and with plant-side systems through APIs, middleware, or lab-data platforms.
* Experience delivering to GxP, data integrity, and computer system validation expectations.
* Working agentic capability: tool calling, MCP or an equivalent interface, and human-in-the-loop design, with an eye on safe action against validated systems.
* Python and SQL skills sufficient to build against LIMS and enterprise interfaces.
* Experience partnering with scientists, QA, and system owners to shape technical priorities.

**Additional Qualifications / Competencies**

* Direct experience with a TetraScience-type lab-data platform.
* Experience with MES, DMS, or ELN integrations and document-to-schema conversion.
* Familiarity with ontologies or knowledge graphs as a source of agent grounding.
* Experience directing partner or vendor delivery on instrument integration.
* Experience designing agent-to-agent communication or multi-agent patterns beyond single tool calls.
* Comfortable presenting technical strategy and trade-offs to senior, non-technical stakeholders.
* Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

**Required Leadership Capabilities**

* Goes deep technically on lab and plant systems while translating integration trade-offs into business-relevant narratives.
* Owns and defends an integration and configuration roadmap in front of scientists and business audiences.
* Provides day-to-day technical guidance and mentorship without requiring a formal people-manager structure.
* Systems thinking that connects lab and plant system design to downstream agentic workflows and business outcomes.

**Advisor/Senior Advisor – Process Engineering and Modeling, Chromatography & Process Systems (R5)**
**Organization Overview**
Lilly unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly has a nearly 150-year heritage of scientific innovation, excellence, integrity, and respect for people.
  
  
The Product Research and Development (PRD) organization develops and delivers quality medicines to patients by advancing Lilly’s portfolio across small molecules, synthetic peptides, insulins, monoclonal antibodies, novel therapeutic proteins, oligonucleotide therapies, and gene therapy systems. PRD is a multidisciplinary organization that collaborates across therapeutic business units and manufacturing to deliver clinical and commercial medicines globally.
  
  
Lilly-Bengaluru, India is a strategic investment to attract top scientific and technical talent from India’s vibrant academic and professional environment. The PRD team in Bengaluru works closely with PRD colleagues in Indianapolis and across the global organization to enable delivery of Lilly’s portfolio.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Advisor – Process Engineering and Modeling will provide technical leadership in modeling, simulation, data science, and process engineering to support small molecule and synthetic peptide drug substance development. The role applies deep scientific, engineering, mathematical, and computational expertise to solve problems in chromatography purification, reaction systems, and other unit operations at both small and large scale.
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical depth, broad modeling capability, scientific leadership, and a collaborative approach to solving complex process development and manufacturing challenges.
  
  

* Develop and apply customized computer models, computational tools, and commercial modeling software to support process understanding and decision-making.
* Use modeling and simulation to inform process development, scale-up, technology transfer, manufacturing, and validation.
* Apply artificial intelligence and machine learning methods to solve process engineering problems and extract insight from complex data sets.
* Contribute to research projects and programs focused on development of small molecule and synthetic peptide active pharmaceutical ingredients for clinical and commercial use.
* Design data-rich experiments using automated laboratory reactors, process analytical technology probes, and appropriate kinetic, thermodynamic, and transport measurements to support impurity control and manufacturing scale-up.
* Improve research and development effectiveness through computer modeling, simulation, optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead modeling activities for small molecule and synthetic peptide drug substance development, including mechanistic modeling, data-driven modeling, simulation, and optimization.
* Design and develop model-derived solutions to support clinical and commercial manufacturing processes, including batch and continuous processes, material supply, registration-enabling process understanding, and robust control strategies.
* Identify and communicate process risks, design opportunities, and modeling-based recommendations to project teams and management to enable sound technical and business decisions.
* Use internal and external modeling and experimental resources to mitigate technical risks before they affect project delivery timelines.
* Partner with product teams to provide technical oversight for process scale-up and technology transfer to internal manufacturing sites and external CDMOs.
* Collaborate across PRD to identify decisions that can be informed by data science, statistical modeling, machine learning, and process engineering analysis.
* Select and apply fit-for-purpose data science tools and methodologies to influence development decisions.
* Develop tools and algorithms to mine patterns in existing data and generate recommendations for future experiments, process questions, and modeling strategies.
* Communicate model assumptions, limitations, results, and recommendations clearly to scientific, engineering, manufacturing, and leadership stakeholders.
* Mentor and influence project teams by promoting model-informed development, scientific rigor, and an Agile mindset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 0–5 years of industry experience in modeling, simulation, process engineering, or data science applied to pharmaceutical process development.
* Substantial computer modeling expertise, including application and/or development of modeling tools for process engineering problems.
* Demonstrated experience with process development, scale-up, and technology transfer to internal manufacturing sites or external CDMOs.
* Strong foundation in mathematical analysis, advanced mathematics, and applied problem solving for science- and engineering-based systems.
* Proficiency with mathematical analysis and process modeling programs such as JMP, MATLAB, ASPEN, Dynochem, or gPROMS.
* Experience programming in scripting languages such as R or Python.
* Experience using statistical or machine learning tools, with the ability to implement custom algorithms as needed.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions, influence technical decisions, and drive solutions with an Agile mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience applying optimization, computational fluid dynamics, and computational chemistry tools to solve process engineering problems.
* Experience with chromatography purification experimentation and modelling.
* Experience designing data-rich experiments using automated lab reactors and process analytical technology probes.
* Experience translating kinetic, thermodynamic, and transport data into process understanding, impurity control strategies, and scale-up recommendations.
* Successful interaction with senior engineering and scientific personnel across matrixed project teams.

**Additional Information**

* Limited international travel, approximately 2–4%, may be required.
* Work-hour flexibility is required to support collaboration across multiple time zones.
