jobs.description:
**Description**
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.
  
  
The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
* Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
* Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) Technical Service: Distilling & Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.
  
  
You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
* Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
* Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
* Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
* Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech), Master’s degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
* Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
* Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: BI Manager, KYBP, Business Partner Integrity, and Strategic Transactions
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only authorities in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the operation and continuous improvement of Business Integrity’s Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) / Business Partner Integrity programme, helping ensure that integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored through a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach aligned to the Spirit of Integrity Framework.
  
  
The role will drive transformation and process improvement across the end-to-end KYBP lifecycle, working across Business Integrity and with Procurement, Commercial, D&T and other enterprise partners to simplify and strengthen processes, improve user experience, and make effective use of data, technology and automation. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, the role will also help find opportunities to align approaches, capabilities and ways of working across the function where relevant.
  
  
More broadly, the role will provide flexible project, analytical and operational capability across the Compliance Operations portfolio, supporting wider priorities and continuous improvement as the BI programme evolves.
  
  

* Lead the KYBP / Business Partner Integrity programme: Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the KYBP element of the Spirit of Integrity Framework, ensuring a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, approving and monitoring integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners.
* Drive KYBP transformation and end-to-end process excellence: Lead transformation and improvement across the end-to-end KYBP / KYC / TPRM lifecycle, working across Procurement, Commercial, OpCoP, the TPRM Control Tower, Legal, Finance, D&T and markets to simplify processes, strengthen handoffs and accountabilities, improve user experience and embed scalable and sustainable ways of working. Work with Legal Operations and other partners where there are opportunities to demonstrate common approaches to process improvement, service delivery or transformation.
* Maintain KYBP standards, methodology and risk-based decision-making: Develop and maintain the standards, procedures, playbooks and methodology supporting KYBP, including risk segmentation, due diligence requirements, screening, red flags, issue, mitigation and ongoing monitoring. Work with relevant risk-domain SMEs to ensure appropriate coverage of bribery and corruption, sanctions, money laundering, failure to prevent fraud, facilitation of tax evasion and other relevant integrity risks.
* Strengthen data, technology, monitoring and programme effectiveness: Use data, insight and monitoring to understand the effectiveness of the KYBP programme and find opportunities for continuous improvement. Define business requirements and work with D&T, Compliance Operations and other partners to improve systems, workflows, automation and AI-enabled capabilities supporting business partner integrity. Support complex or non-standard business relationships and strategic transactions, including relevant joint venture and M&A due diligence, risk assessment, mitigation and integration requirements.
* Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible analytical, project and operational support across the wider Compliance Operations agenda, responding to evolving priorities and opportunities to strengthen the BI programme. This may include projects and initiatives across Speak Up and breach management, BI controls, policy governance, training and engagement, risk assessment and monitoring, data and analytics, regulatory developments, external benchmarking and other elements of the Spirit of Integrity Framework. Provide appropriate resilience and cover for key Compliance Operations activities as required. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, give to cross-functional initiatives where relevant to the role's expertise and capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Business Partner Risk and Compliance Judgement: Strong understanding of third-party and business partner integrity risk, with the ability to apply risk-based and proportionate judgement across due diligence, screening, mitigation, issue and ongoing monitoring.
* Process Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement: Understands how processes, systems, data and controls connect, and identifies practical opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and continuously improve end-to-end ways of working.
* Problem Solving, Delivery and Partner Management: Brings structure to complex, cross-functional problems, handles projects and priorities effectively, and works collaboratively across stakeholders to translate requirements and ideas into practical, sustainable outcomes

**Experience / Skills Required**

* Relevant experience in ethics and compliance, third-party risk management, KYC/KYBP, consulting, transformation or a related field.
* Experience in third-party or business partner compliance risk, including areas such as due diligence, bribery and corruption, sanctions, AML, fraud or other relevant integrity risks.
* Strong transformation, process improvement and project management capability, with experience delivering change across complex, cross-functional processes.
* Strong analytical and digital capability, with experience using data, technology, automation or workflow tools to improve processes and programme effectiveness; consulting or professional services experience would be helpful.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  

* Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
* We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, give and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to improve, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to give an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

jobs.title: Poultry Nutrition Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

**Job Description**
**Job title: Senior Manager - Federal Tax Compliance**
**Contract: permanent**
**Location: Budapest**
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced tax professional to lead the company’s U.S. federal corporate income tax compliance function. This role, located in Budapest, will have primary responsibility for the accurate and timely completion of federal income tax filings and related compliance processes and will support the broader tax team on tax accounting, planning, tax controversy, and other federal tax matters.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong U.S. corporate income tax technical expertise, excellent project management skills, and a continuous improvement mindset. This individual will work closely with colleagues across Tax, Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and other functions, as well as external tax advisors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Federal Income Tax Compliance**

* Lead and oversee the preparation and review of the company’s U.S. federal corporate income tax returns, including Form 1120 and related forms, schedules, elections, and disclosures.
* Manage the annual federal income tax compliance calendar to ensure all filing, payment, and documentation requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* Oversee the preparation and review of federal taxable income calculations, book-to-tax adjustments, tax attributes, and supporting workpapers.
* Manage federal estimated tax payments, extensions, and related cash tax calculations.
* Review and maintain appropriate documentation supporting significant federal tax positions and elections.
* Coordinate the federal tax return process with internal teams and external tax advisors.
* Ensure appropriate integration between federal compliance and other areas of the tax function, including state, international, and transfer pricing.
* Develop and maintain accurate forecasts of U.S. federal cash tax payments, proactively identifying and communicating changes, risks, and opportunities to Tax leadership and Treasury.

**Tax Accounting and Planning/Controversy Support**

* Lead the ASC 740 income tax provision process, including federal current and deferred tax calculations and return-to-provision adjustments.
* Review and assess uncertain tax positions, including the adequacy of supporting technical analysis and documentation, and support the appropriate recognition and measurement of such positions
* Perform ETR analyses and manage the ETR forecasting process, including identifying, analyzing, and communicating key drivers of actual and forecasted ETR to Tax and Finance leadership.
* Support tax planning initiatives through federal tax research, analysis, modeling, and implementation.
* Assist in evaluating the federal tax implications of business transactions, restructurings, acquisitions, dispositions, and other strategic initiatives.
* Support federal tax examinations and controversy matters, including preparation of responses to IRS inquiries and Information Document Requests.
* Provide calculations, documentation, and technical analysis in support of matters under examination.
* Assist in maintaining documentation related to federal tax positions and applicable statutes of limitation.
* Support tax leadership, internal and external counsel, and external tax advisors in connection with federal tax controversy matters.

**Process Improvement and Controls**

* Identify and implement opportunities to improve, standardize, and automate federal tax compliance processes.
* Enhance the use of tax technology and data analytics to improve accuracy, efficiency, and controls.
* Maintain strong process documentation and SOX controls related to federal income tax compliance.
* Partner with Finance and technology teams to improve the quality and accessibility of tax data.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Serve as a key U.S. federal income tax compliance resource to the broader Tax organization and other business functions.
* Manage the relationship with the company’s external auditor on U.S. federal income tax matters, coordinating requests, addressing tax-related audit questions, and ensuring timely resolution of issues.
* Manage and develop team members, as applicable, promoting appropriate delegation, accountability, and professional development.
* Coordinate external advisors supporting the federal compliance process and manage related deliverables.
* Communicate complex tax matters clearly and effectively to tax and non-tax stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, taxation, or a related field; advanced degree in taxation preferred.
* Progressive experience in U.S. federal corporate income taxation, preferably involving large and/or multinational corporations.
* Strong technical knowledge of U.S. federal corporate income tax law and consolidated corporate income tax returns.
* Significant experience managing complex federal income tax compliance processes.
* Deep knowledge of ASC 740 and the interaction between tax compliance and the income tax provision.
* Experience supporting tax planning initiatives and IRS examinations.
* Experience with tax compliance technology and large ERP/data environments.
* Strong analytical, project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a complex environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external advisors.

**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

jobs.title: Factory Manager / Plant Manager (Food Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

**About RootsDesi**

**Vision:** Bringing pure, desi dairy and daily essentials, grown on our farms and made the way Grandma did, to every Indian home.

**Mission:** We are on a mission to bring back the goodness our grandparents trusted. On our own farms we raise native Gir cows and feed them natural fodder grown with their own manure. This natural ecosystem gives us A2 milk, ghee, paneer and everyday desi groceries, made the way our grandparents made them, and delivered farm-fresh to Indian homes.

**Tagline:** Just Pure Desi — made the way Grandma did.

Today our customers are families who have visited the farm and the people they recommend. This role takes RootsDesi from there to homes across India and to Indian families abroad.

What you will sell: A2 milk (daily delivery); bilona ghee, curd, buttermilk, lassi, paneer, colostrum milk, butter, khoa and sweets; groundnut, coconut, sesame and other wood-pressed oils. Ghee and oils are sold in India and abroad; fresh products in India only. More products will be added based on what customers ask for.

**Role summary**

Sell our milk, dairy products and wood-pressed oils across India, and our ghee and oils abroad, profitably, and build the team to run it. You report directly to the CEO.

**Area**

**What you deliver**

**Measured by**

Revenue growth, active customers, business customers, and the mix of direct and business sales.

**Brand and marketing**

Content, performance marketing and community; our real farm, cows and team; new products added on customer demand, and those that do not sell paused.

Cost to win a customer, new products live on schedule, reviews and rating.

Every customer and subscription in the CRM; service complaints (delivery, billing, subscriptions) resolved fast; customers asked what they want.

Repeat purchase rate, subscription retention, service complaint resolution time.

Daily cold-chain delivery for fresh dairy; dense routes that pay for themselves; ghee and oils shipped across India and abroad through partners.

On-time delivery, cost per order, damage in transit.

Milk available to plan, every lot tested, zero wastage of perishables, forecast accuracy.

Every batch tracked from milk to customer and a recall plan ready; product quality complaints acted on fast; an SOP for every activity; launch only with an FSSAI-checked label, shelf-life test and lab report; every claim within ASCI norms.

You will be reporting to the Manager, Internal Audit India. People Incs global Internal Audit function performs operational, financial and information technology audits and data analytic/automation projects for IA across all of People Inc locations and businesses. The skills necessary to succeed in this position include strong organization skills, ability to collaborate and partner with our businesses, audit expertise, effective communication and ability to conduct audit testing independently. * Proactive, organized, and able to manage competing priorities to deliver timely completion of assignments

* High standards of ethics and professionalism

Position Purpose

To lead the Biotechnology R&D function for development, optimization, scale-up and commercialization of biotechnology-based processes for APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, specialty chemicals and other value-added products.

The position will be responsible for converting scientific concepts and laboratory processes into commercially viable, robust, safe, scalable and cost-effective manufacturing processes.

The role will also drive innovation through fermentation, microbial biotechnology, enzymatic transformation, biocatalysis, strain improvement, process intensification and sustainable manufacturing technologies.

  

Key Responsibilities

A. R&D Strategy and Technology Development

* Develop and execute the company's 35-year biotechnology R&D strategy aligned with business objectives.

* Build internal biotechnology capabilities and technology platforms.

Product and Process Development

* Lead biotechnology process development from laboratory proof-of-concept through pilot and commercial scale.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager - Regulatory & Clinical Development
jobs.description:
**Role Details -** Project Manager supporting Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, and Medical Affairs

  

**Role Summary**

  

**The IT Project Manager**  Regulatory & Clinical Development is responsible for leading the planning, implementation, validation, and lifecycle management of technology solutions that support Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, and Medical Affairs functions.

This role ensures that all regulated systems are compliant with global health authority requirements including the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, and other international regulatory bodies.

The position acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders (Regulatory, Clinical, PV, Quality) and IT teams to deliver compliant, secure, and scalable systems aligned with corporate strategy and product development timelines.

  

**1. Regulatory Systems Implementation & Management**

Lead implementation and lifecycle management of Regulatory Information Management Systems (RIMS), eCTD publishing tools, and submission platforms (e.g., **Veeva Systems**, **Oracle Corporation** Argus Safety).

  

**2. Clinical Systems Oversight**

Manage deployment and upgrades of Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), EDC, and eTMF platforms aligned with clinical development goals.

  

**3. Compliance & Validation (CSV/CSA)**

Ensure IT systems comply with **U.S. Food and Drug Administration** 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, Annex 11, and global regulatory standards through proper validation and documentation.

  

**4. Pharmacovigilance & Safety Systems**

Oversee safety databases, signal detection tools, and integration with global safety reporting systems.

  

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Quality, and PV teams to align IT initiatives with strategic business objectives.

  

**6. Project Governance & Portfolio Management**

Establish governance frameworks, manage project charters, budgets, timelines, KPIs, and executive reporting.

  

**7. Vendor & Third-Party Management**

Manage relationships with technology vendors, CROs, and SaaS providers, including SLAs, performance metrics, and contract compliance.

  

**8. Data Integrity & Governance**

Ensure ALCOA+ principles, master data governance, metadata standards, and audit readiness across regulated systems.

  

**9. System Integration & Interoperability**

Oversee integrations between CTMS, EDC, RIMS, Safety, ERP, and document management systems.

  

**10. Inspection & Audit Readiness Support**

Support regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA) by ensuring validated systems, audit trails, and documentation readiness.

  

**11. Risk Management & Issue Resolution**

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project and compliance risks using structured risk management frameworks.

  

**12. Budget & Resource Management**

Develop and manage annual IT budgets, resource allocation, forecasting, and cost optimization initiatives.

  

**13. Change Management & User Adoption**

Lead organizational change management, user training, communication plans, and adoption strategies for new systems.

  

**14. Innovation & Digital Transformation**

Drive automation, AI-enabled analytics, cloud transformation, and digital solutions supporting regulatory intelligence and clinical operations.

  

**15. Cybersecurity & Data Privacy Compliance**

Ensure systems comply with global privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and corporate cybersecurity standards to protect sensitive clinical and patient data.

Strong hands-on experience is required across Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting, together with good working experience in Java and Python and experience processing high-volume transaction and reference data.

jobs.title: Assistant Registrar-Legal & Compliance
jobs.description:
**Role Summary:**

The Assistant Registrar – Legal & Compliance will support the Registrar and University leadership in managing legal, regulatory, statutory and governance-related matters of the University. The role will be responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, University statutes, ordinances and regulatory requirements; supporting the drafting and review of legal and institutional documents; coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory authorities; and ensuring proper documentation and timely follow-up on legal and compliance matters.

The position will also support the University's statutory bodies, policy development, risk mitigation, and legal aspects of matters relating to students, faculty, staff, contracts, institutional assets and other administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Legal Affairs & Advisory:**

* Provide legal support and assistance to the Registrar and University leadership on institutional, academic, employment, contractual and administrative matters.
* Draft, review and vet agreements, MoUs, contracts, service agreements, NDAs, undertakings, notices and other legal documents.
* Review legal implications of proposed institutional initiatives, partnerships, contracts and administrative decisions and provide appropriate inputs.
* Coordinate responses to legal notices, claims, disputes and litigation in consultation with the Registrar and external legal counsel.
* Maintain an organised repository of legal documents, agreements, notices, case records and related correspondence.
* Maintain a comprehensive register of agreements/MoUs and monitor their validity, renewal and key contractual obligations.

**Regulatory & Statutory Compliance:**

* Monitor compliance with the applicable University Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, AICTE requirements, State higher education laws and other applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.
* Track changes in education, employment, labour, data protection and other relevant laws and communicate their implications to concerned stakeholders.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of statutory returns, reports, declarations and other regulatory filings within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and follow up with concerned departments/schools for timely fulfilment of statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support the University during regulatory inspections, audits, accreditation processes and other statutory reviews from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Assist in identifying gaps in compliance and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

**University Governance :**

* Support the functioning of statutory and governance bodies of the University, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council and other committees, as assigned.
* Assist in preparing legal notes, background documents and compliance inputs for meetings of statutory bodies.
* Support the Registrar's Office in ensuring proper documentation, follow-up and implementation of decisions/resolutions of statutory bodies.
* Assist in reviewing University policies, rules, regulations and procedures to ensure consistency with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records relating to statutory approvals, resolutions, legal opinions and governance-related matters.

**Student, Faculty & Staff Related Legal Matters:**

* Provide legal and compliance support in matters relating to student discipline, grievances, academic integrity and other student-related issues.
* Support HR in matters relating to employment contracts, service rules, disciplinary proceedings and applicable labour/employment laws.
* Assist in reviewing service agreements, consultancy arrangements and other employment-related documentation.
* Support the handling of information disclosure, RTI-related matters, data privacy and other confidentiality-related requirements, as applicable.
* Ensure that appropriate legal and procedural safeguards are considered while dealing with sensitive institutional matters.

**Risk Management & Coordination:**

* Identify potential legal and regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Support the development and implementation of compliance mechanisms, checklists and standard operating procedures.
* Liaise with external lawyers, legal consultants, government departments, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments for resolution of legal and compliance issues and ensure timely closure of identified matters.
* Support internal audits, reviews and investigations relating to legal, regulatory and compliance matters.
* Maintain appropriate records and reports on the status of legal, regulatory and compliance matters.

**General Responsibilities:**

* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive legal, institutional and personal information.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation and professional integrity in all legal and compliance-related work.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Registrar from time to time.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognised university/institution.
* LL.M. or an additional qualification in Corporate Law, Education Law, Compliance or a related area will be an advantage.
* Enrolment with the Bar Council is preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant post-qualification experience in legal, regulatory, compliance or university administration roles.
* Experience in a higher education institution, university, educational trust, statutory body or large organisation with significant regulatory exposure will be preferred.
* Experience in drafting and reviewing contracts, MoUs and other legal documents is essential.
* Experience in handling legal notices, disputes and coordination with external legal counsel is desirable.
* Experience in dealing with UGC, AICTE, State higher education authorities or other regulatory/statutory bodies will be an advantage.
* Experience in university governance, statutory bodies, policy development and regulatory compliance will be preferred.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of applicable education laws, University regulations, UGC/AICTE requirements, contract law and employment/labour laws.
* Working knowledge of data protection and privacy requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection framework.
* Excellent legal drafting, documentation, research and analytical skills.
* Ability to interpret legal and regulatory provisions and translate them into clear, practical guidance.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with senior leadership, faculty, administrative teams, external counsel and regulatory authorities.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines simultaneously.
* High level of integrity, discretion, confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and legal research/document management tools.

jobs.description:
**About Reward360**
Reward360 (R360) is a technology-driven customer engagement and loyalty solutions company that enables banks and leading brands to build and manage customer engagement, rewards, and loyalty programmes. Through its technology platform, R360 supports rewards marketplaces, digital commerce, payments, and customer engagement solutions.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a senior in-house legal professional to independently lead the legal function at Reward360. The ideal candidate should have experience managing the complete legal and compliance function of a mid-sized company or start-up, with the ability to handle complex commercial contracts, regulatory requirements, data privacy, and business advisory.
  
  
This role requires a commercially minded legal professional who can work closely with the Board, senior management, and cross-functional teams while ensuring strong legal governance and regulatory compliance across the organisation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Independently own and manage the organisation's legal function and end-to-end legal compliance.
* Act as the Nodal Officer and lead organisation-wide DPDP compliance, covering R360's own data and its obligations as a Data Processor for clients, as applicable.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage commercial contracts, including MSAs, SOWs, SLAs, NDAs, technology agreements, vendor agreements, and partner agreements.
* Lead contract negotiations with banks and financial institutions, particularly on data processing, outsourcing, information security, audit, and regulatory clauses.
* Provide day-to-day legal and commercial advisory to business teams and senior management.
* Build and oversee a legal and regulatory risk management framework, including identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks.
* Oversee employment-related legal compliance, including POSH requirements.
* Manage litigation, disputes, legal notices, and external legal counsel, including briefing and monitoring law firms and consultants within approved budgets.
* Work closely with the Board of Directors and business heads, as well as InfoSec, HR, and Finance teams, on legal, contractual, and compliance matters.

Key Requirements
  
  

* 8–12 years of post-qualification experience in corporate legal, commercial contracts, compliance, and advisory roles.
* LLB / LLM from a reputed law school in India is mandatory.
* Experience independently managing the legal function of a mid-sized company or start-up.
* Preferred industry background in fintech, BFSI, loyalty, payments, SaaS, or technology services.
* Strong working knowledge of data privacy, including the DPDP Act and applicable Rules, with the ability to lead organisation-wide compliance.
* Hands-on experience in commercial contracts, technology agreements, and corporate law.
* Proven experience negotiating contracts with banks and financial institutions.
* Working knowledge of the IT Act and RBI guidelines relevant to BFSI clients.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and SOC 2 from a compliance perspective.
* Experience developing and managing legal and regulatory risk frameworks.
* Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive presence.
* Ability to provide commercially practical legal advice and work independently while managing multiple stakeholders.

Good to Have
  
  

* Qualified Company Secretary (ACS/FCS).
* Privacy or information security certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, DCPP, or ISO 27701 Lead Implementer.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Bangalore.
  
  
At QIMA, we’re on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust.
  
  
Working with over 30,000 global brands, retailers, manufacturers and food growers, we are on the ground wherever products are made. Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. The work directly protects response time and resolves transmission issues for our integration clients, freeing up senior IAS/RPA team members to focus on higher-complexity work.

* Identify ticket trends and work with internal partners on process improvements.

jobs.title: Institutional Investment Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About This Role**  

Wells Fargo is seeking an **Institutional Investment Operations Specialist**.

  
  
**In This Role, You Will**  

The team member will be part of the **Markets Client Delivery Onboarding team**, responsible for supporting client onboarding across Markets businesses, including **FX, Rates, Equities, Fixed Income, Futures, Commodities, Commercial Real Estate, and Prime Services**.

The role involves coordinating end-to-end onboarding activities, including client data collection, validation, system setup, and stakeholder engagement. As a central point of contact, the team member will work closely with Front Office/Sales, Operations, KYC, Credit, and Documentation teams to facilitate timely client onboarding, provide status updates, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

The team member will also contribute to process improvement and transformation initiatives aimed at enhancing client experience, strengthening controls, and improving operational efficiency.

* Participate in lifecycle support activities for institutional trade initiatives and identify opportunities for process improvements.
* Assist leadership in bringing individuals and teams together to resolve complex issues.
* Support client account onboarding, cash payment input and monitoring, customer service, project support, funding operations, custodial operations, securities settlement services, structured loan operations, and general ledger reconciliation.
* Support the resolution of confirmation and ISDA-related issues.
* Provide subject matter expertise on projects and internal and industry-related initiatives.
* Review and analyze operational activities requiring research, evaluation, and independent judgment.
* Present recommendations for resolving complex situations and exercise independent judgment while developing expertise across functions and projects.
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and managers to resolve issues and achieve business objectives.

  
  
**Required Qualifications**  

* **2+ years of Institutional Investment Operations experience**, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of work experience, training, military experience, or education.

  
  
**Desired Qualifications**  

* Experience in **Client Onboarding, Client Lifecycle Management, and Corporate Investment Banking**.
* Strong knowledge of Markets products and trade lifecycle processes, including **Securities, Fixed Income, Equities, FX, Futures, Derivatives, and related post-trade activities**.
* Comprehensive understanding of onboarding and regulatory requirements, including **KYC, CDD, EDD, AML, Tax Documentation, ISDA, SSI setup, and regulatory due diligence**.
* Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as **FINRA, Dodd-Frank, Qualified Financial Contracts (QFC), and other applicable banking regulations**.
* Ability to interpret and analyze legal agreements, regulatory requirements, client documentation, and complex operational processes.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and managing deliverables across multiple teams and business functions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify risks, evaluate controls, and recommend practical solutions.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word**, with experience using reporting and visualization tools such as **Tableau** and industry platforms including **Markit and DTCC/ALERT**.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and build effective working relationships.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or a related field preferred**.

  
  
**Job Expectations**  

* Serve as the primary case manager for end-to-end client onboarding activities, ensuring timely and accurate delivery throughout the onboarding lifecycle.
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate a seamless onboarding experience while meeting client, business, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate across **Front Office, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Credit, Documentation, Collateral, and Client Account teams** to ensure all prerequisites are completed before trading commences.
* Execute onboarding activities with a strong focus on **risk management, control adherence, data quality, and regulatory compliance**.
* Drive operational excellence by identifying process enhancements, automation opportunities, and control improvements that enhance client experience and efficiency.
* Support business growth initiatives by providing subject matter expertise on onboarding requirements, regulatory developments, and industry changes.
* Lead or contribute to strategic transformation initiatives, partnering with Technology and key stakeholders to deliver sustainable process improvements.
* Prepare management reporting, analyze metrics, and provide actionable insights to support business decisions and performance management.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of accuracy, responsiveness, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.title: Package Consultant-Workday Absence, Time Tracking, Payroll
jobs.description:
**Your Role and Responsibilities:**

As a Package Consultant for Workday Absence, Time Tracking, and Payroll, you will guide clients through the implementation, customization, and continuous improvement of Workday's human capital management (HCM) solutions, focusing on the Absence, Time Tracking, and Payroll modules. You will ensure seamless integration and optimal performance, leveraging your knowledge of modern time tracking methodologies, global payroll regulations, and absence management best practices.

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include:**

* **Design Efficient Time Management Processes:** Design and configure time management processes to meet clients' specific needs, aligning with their policies and regulatory requirements. This includes creating efficient workflows and ensuring accurate time recording and leave management.
* **Configure Payroll Structures:** Set up and manage payroll structures to ensure compliance with global payroll regulations and clients' policies. This involves collaborating with clients to understand their payroll requirements and configuring the system accordingly.
* **Manage Absences:** Implement and manage absence management processes, ensuring alignment with clients' policies and regulatory requirements. This includes setting up absence rules, accruals, and leave management.
* **Lead Workshops and Training Sessions:** Deliver workshops and training sessions to end-users, enabling them to effectively utilize the Absence, Time Tracking, and Payroll modules for accurate time recording, leave management, and payroll processing.
* **Provide Post-Go-Live Support:** Offer post-implementation support, including data validation and troubleshooting, to ensure smooth system operation and resolve any issues that may arise.

**Required Education:**

Bachelor's Degree

**Preferred Education:**

Master's Degree

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

* **Exposure to Workday HCM Solutions:** Familiarity with Workday's human capital management (HCM) solutions, specifically the Absence, Time Tracking, and Payroll modules, including their implementation, customization, and continuous improvement.
* **Understanding of Time Tracking Methodologies:** Knowledge of modern time tracking methodologies, including efficient time management processes and accurate time recording.
* **Global Payroll Regulations:** Familiarity with global payroll regulations and absence management best practices, including compliance requirements and regulatory frameworks.
* **Experience with System Configuration:** Exposure to configuring payroll structures, setting up absence rules, accruals, and leave management, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.
* **Training and Workshop Delivery:** Experience delivering workshops and training sessions to end-users, enabling them to effectively utilize HCM solutions for accurate time recording, leave management, and payroll processing.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

* **Advanced Workday HCM Knowledge:** Exposure to advanced Workday HCM features and functionalities, including data analytics and reporting, to drive business insights and optimize HCM solutions.
* **Specialized Time Tracking Methodologies:** Familiarity with specialized time tracking methodologies, such as those used in specific industries or regions, to design tailored time management processes for clients.
* **Multi-Country Payroll Regulations:** Knowledge of multi-country payroll regulations and compliance requirements to ensure seamless payroll processing across different countries and regions.

****Years of Experience:****7 - 9

jobs.title: FirstClub - Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain Domain
jobs.description:
**About FirstClub**
At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
  
  
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
  
  
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
  
  
**The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain**

* Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
* Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
* Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
* Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
* Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
* Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
* Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
* Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.

**Why FirstClub**

* Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
* Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
* Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
* Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
* Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
* Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.

**The Role**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub - from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member.
  
  
Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.
* Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter : availability and fill rate, promise adherence, inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.
* Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.
* Architect the core systems with Engineering : a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.
* Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.
* Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners - making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.
* Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.
* Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons : forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.
* Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture - pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.
* Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.
* Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 - 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.
* Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.
* Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.
* Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.
* Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.
* Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.
* Strong analytical depth : comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.
* An AI-native mindset : you think naturally about how ML, automation and agents can change how decisions get made, not just how screens look.
* Excellent stakeholder management with senior Operations, Category, Finance and Engineering leaders.
* You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments : you'll write the spec, pull the data and walk the floor yourself, and you know the answer is usually a mix of technology, process and operational change.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
* An MBA is a plus; strong product experience matters more.

**Good To Have**

* Built or scaled a WMS, inventory platform, procurement system, TMS or promise/ETA engine.
* Experience with fresh, perishable and cold-chain supply chains, including FEFO, grading and expiry management.
* Exposure to demand forecasting, replenishment optimization, slotting, network planning or routing.
* Experience launching and scaling operations across multiple cities and high daily order volumes.
* Experience building frontline workforce products : productivity tracking, incentives, gamification or training.
* Experience shipping AI/ML-driven decisioning or agentic workflows in production operations.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Associate Product Manager?**

We are looking for a motivated, result-oriented and who is passionate about solving real-world business and user problems through technology and design.

In this role, you will take ownership of key product areas, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and translate customer insights and business requirements into scalable product solutions. You will work closely with engineering, design, and business teams to drive product development, ensure seamless execution, and deliver impactful solutions.

If you are enthusiastic about building innovative products and making a difference in the food-tech industry, we would love to have you on our team!

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Solutioning: Translate business challenges and requirements into well-defined product solutions, outlining scope, possible approaches, dependencies, and edge cases.
* Product Discovery: Drive product discovery through user research, market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and customer insights to identify opportunities and shape product strategy.
* Product Documentation: Create and maintain product documentation, including Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, release notes
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with engineering teams to assess technical feasibility, understand dependencies, evaluate effort estimates
* Design Collaboration: Partner with UI/UX teams to develop wireframes and mock-ups using tools such as Figma, ensuring designs align with business and product requirements.
* Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate with engineering, design, business, and customer success teams to ensure smooth product execution and delivery.
* Product Performance: Monitor product performance through customer feedback, and data analysis to identify improvement opportunities and drive continuous enhancement.
* Agile Product Management: Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and release management while promoting Agile best practices.
* Delivery Management: Track product features throughout development, testing, and deployment, proactively follow up on dependencies and blockers, and provide regular progress updates to stakeholders

**Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience in Product Management, preferably within a B2B technology environment.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Experience in contributing to product launches, feature development, and product enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Analytical mindset with hands-on experience in working with data, KPIs, metrics, and OKRs.
* Familiarity with product discovery methodologies, user research, and market analysis.
* Understanding of wireframing and prototyping, with exposure to tools such as Figma.
* Experience in creating PRDs, user stories, Jira tickets, and acceptance criteria.
* Good understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-driven, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Quality & Operational Excellence Special  

**What we believe in**

  

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

  

In this role The Quality Specialist – Supplier Quality, Vendor Development & Incoming Inspection is responsible for end-to-end supplier quality management for vendors engaged in manufacturing processes including Molding (Injection/Compression), Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating. This role encompasses vendor qualification, process development, quality audits, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) implementation, incoming material inspection, and corrective action management. This role demands solid knowledge in Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) operation, dimensional metrology, process-specific quality parameters, supplier audits, PPAP methodologies, APQP/FMEA tools, and ISO 9001:2015 compliance within a manufacturing environment.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification, Smart Building Business to be based at Nelamangala, Bangalore India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Supplier Qualification & Development – Evaluate, qualify, and develop suppliers across Molding, Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating processes through capability assessments, process audits, quality system audits, supplier scorecards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Supplier Audits & PPAP Management – Plan and conduct initial, periodic, and surveillance audits; manage PPAP Level 0–5 for new parts and engineering/process changes, reviewing PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, FAI, and PSW documentation.
* Incoming Quality & Process Control – Manage IQC activities and material clearance through SAP Usage Decision (UD), while establishing process-specific inspection standards and monitoring critical quality parameters, Cp/Cpk, SPC, and measurement system effectiveness.
* Supplier Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions – Manage supplier rejection, RGA, NC tracking, 8D corrective actions, SNCRP, root-cause analysis, and verification of corrective action effectiveness; support resolution of supplier-related customer complaints.
* Supplier Performance, Compliance & Quality Assurance – Lead supplier performance reviews, monitor Defect PPM, OTD, Cost, Cp/Cpk, and responsiveness, maintain quality documentation and certifications, and ensure compliance with applicable IEC, UL, CE, RoHS, ISO 9001:2015, and customer-specific requirements.

**Qualifications for the role:**

  

* B.E./B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, or Quality Assurance within a manufacturing environment.
* Practical experience in at least 2–3 manufacturing processes, including Injection Molding, Metal Stamping, Resistance Welding, and Plating.
* Minimum 3 years of practical experience in supplier audits, vendor assessments, process audits, and supplier qualification.
* Practical experience in PPAP, APQP, PFMEA/FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA/Gauge R&R, GD&T, and supplier approval processes.
* Mandatory proficiency in CMM operation and programming, using ZEISS CALYPSO, along with knowledge of dimensional and material testing.
* Experience in Switchgear, Electrical, Automobile, or Heavy Engineering industries, with knowledge/certification in ISO 9001:2015/IATF 16949, Six Sigma/Lean, PPAP, APQP, FMEA, and process-specific quality standards.
