jobs.title: QA Lead (Agentic Al & Automation Testing)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically proficient **QA Lead** with 10-12 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Manual Testing, Automation Testing, and Test Management.

  

The candidate will be responsible for owning the overall QA function for assigned projects, defining quality engineering strategies, driving automation initiatives, and ensuring the delivery of robust, scalable, and high-quality software solutions.

  

This role requires a strong hands-on technical leader who can independently drive testing activities, design and implement automation frameworks, lead QA teams, manage client and stakeholder expectations, and take complete ownership of product quality throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

The ideal candidate must possess excellent analytical skills, strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and the ability to identify quality risks early and drive continuous improvement.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

1. QA Strategy & Test Management

* Define, establish, and own end-to-end QA strategy, test architecture, and quality engineering processes across projects.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test estimates, and execution strategies based on business and technical requirements.
* Drive functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical designs to identify gaps, dependencies, and potential quality risks.
* Establish quality gates, release criteria, and testing standards to ensure production readiness.
* Manage defect lifecycle, conduct root cause analysis, and drive timely defect resolution.

2. Automation Testing & Framework Development

* Lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of scalable automation frameworks.
* Drive automation initiatives using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or other relevant automation tools.
* Possess strong programming expertise in Java, Python, or JavaScript for developing and maintaining automation scripts.
* Identify suitable automation opportunities and maximize test coverage while reducing manual testing effort.
* Implement automation suites for functional, regression, and API testing.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles.
* Review automation code, framework architecture, test scripts, and technical deliverables to ensure maintainability and reliability.

3. API, Database & Performance Testing

* Lead API testing and validation using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Validate backend processes, database operations, data integrity, and application integrations using SQL.
* Drive performance and load testing initiatives using tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Identify application bottlenecks, analyze performance issues, and coordinate with development teams for resolution.
* Ensure application stability, reliability, scalability, and responsiveness under different workloads.

4. Team Leadership & Delivery Management

* Lead, mentor, and manage QA engineers, automation engineers, and testers across projects.
* Allocate resources, define responsibilities, estimate testing efforts, and manage delivery timelines.
* Conduct technical reviews, provide guidance, and establish consistent testing practices across the team.
* Monitor team productivity, testing progress, defect trends, and quality metrics.
* Drive recruitment support, technical evaluations, onboarding, and capability development within the QA team.
* Take ownership of QA deliverables and ensure commitments are met without compromising quality.

5. Stakeholder & Client Management

* Work closely with Development, Product, Business Analysis, DevOps, and Project Management teams.
* Participate in requirement discussions, sprint planning, technical reviews, and release meetings.
* Communicate testing progress, quality risks, defect status, and release readiness to stakeholders.
* Independently handle client discussions related to testing strategy, quality concerns, and delivery commitments.
* Drive timely resolution of critical issues and ensure clear communication across teams.

6. Process Improvement & Emerging Technologies

* Establish and continuously improve QA processes, standards, frameworks, and best practices.
* Drive adoption of AI-powered testing solutions and intelligent test automation.
* Evaluate and implement modern testing tools and technologies to improve QA efficiency.
* Explore Agentic AI and Generative AI-based testing approaches for test case generation, execution, and defect analysis.
* Promote a quality-first engineering culture across development and delivery teams.

**Mobile Application Testing**

* Lead manual and automation testing of mobile applications across Android and iOS platforms.
* Validate mobile app functionality, UI/UX, usability, compatibility, and device-specific behaviour.
* Perform testing across different devices, screen sizes, OS versions, and network conditions.
* Identify and troubleshoot mobile-specific issues, including installation, performance, crashes, and app responsiveness.
* Experience with mobile automation tools such as **Appium** or similar frameworks.
* Validate mobile APIs, integrations, and end-to-end user workflows.

  

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* 10-12 years of experience in Software Testing and Quality Assurance.
* Strong hands-on experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.
* Proven experience in designing and implementing automation frameworks.
* Strong experience in mobile application testing (Android and iOS).
* Hands-on knowledge of Appium or other mobile automation tools.
* Strong expertise in Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent automation tools.
* Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Strong experience in API testing and backend validation.
* Hands-on experience with SQL and database testing.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, and QA methodologies.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test and defect management tools.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing practices.
* Proven experience leading QA teams and managing end-to-end testing delivery.

  

**Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Preferred.**

Job Description: Data Scientist – Machine Learning & Optimization

**Experience:**
4–6 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

About CoffeeBeans Consulting

CoffeeBeans is a fast-growing technology company delivering high-quality software, data engineering, and AI solutions to clients across industries. We combine deep technical expertise with an agile mindset to solve complex business problems. Our teams work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build intelligent, scalable, and business-focused solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Time-Series Modelling, and Numerical Optimization. The ideal candidate should have experience working with industrial or process-related data and developing predictive models to improve operational efficiency and optimize manufacturing processes.

The role involves reviewing and enhancing existing ML models, developing predictive solutions using historical and real-time industrial data, and applying constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating parameters. The candidate will also work closely with process engineers, plant operators, and domain experts to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, evaluate, and improve Machine Learning models using Python for industrial and process-related applications.
* Work with algorithms such as LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM) for predictive modelling.
* Perform feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and explainability to improve model performance.
* Analyse time-series data, historical process data, sensor readings, equipment performance data, and laboratory data to build predictive models.
* Develop forecasting and predictive solutions using lagged features, process variables, and operational parameters.
* Apply numerical and constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating conditions.
* Work on multi-objective optimization problems involving throughput, recovery, production efficiency, and operational costs.
* Perform sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of different operating parameters.
* Build and maintain ML pipelines, model inference workflows, and deployment processes.
* Perform live model validation and shadow testing by comparing model predictions against actual plant outcomes.
* Implement model monitoring and feedback mechanisms to ensure model reliability and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with process engineers, plant operators, and operational SMEs to understand business requirements and deliver practical solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Python programming and Machine Learning.
* Strong experience in developing and improving ML models.
* Hands-on experience with LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM).
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and model explainability.
* Experience in Time-Series Modelling, forecasting, and predictive analytics.
* Experience working with industrial process data, sensor data, historian data, or equipment performance data.
* Knowledge of numerical optimization, constrained optimization, and multi-objective optimization techniques.
* Experience with operating parameter optimization, sensitivity analysis, or scenario modelling.
* Understanding of ML pipelines, model deployment, inference workflows, and model monitoring.

Good to Have

* Experience in manufacturing, metals, mining, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals, oil & gas, power, or other process industries.
* Experience in manufacturing optimization, industrial process optimization, or production efficiency improvement.
* Familiarity with metaheuristic algorithms and optimization techniques.
* Experience with Kedro (QuantumBlack) or similar ML pipeline frameworks.
* Experience with API integration, live model testing, and shadow deployment.
* Experience working closely with process engineers, plant operators, and industrial domain experts.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can combine strong Machine Learning fundamentals with practical industrial problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with complex, time-dependent industrial datasets, improving existing predictive models, and applying optimization techniques to solve real-world manufacturing and operational challenges.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.

**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React

* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced, and guest-focused **Rooftop Bar Manager** to oversee the complete operations of our premium rooftop bar at a 4-star hotel.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving revenue, managing staff, controlling beverage costs, maintaining service standards, and ensuring profitable operations.

**A. Bar Operations Management**

* Manage daily rooftop bar operations, including opening and closing procedures.

* Maintain 4-star hotel hospitality and service standards.
* Oversee bar setup, ambience, music, lighting, cleanliness, and guest seating arrangements.

* Ensure all bar equipment and facilities are maintained properly.

**B. Revenue Generation & Sales**

* Achieve monthly beverage and food sales targets.
* Develop strategies to increase rooftop bar revenue and profitability.
* Promote signature cocktails, premium beverages, and food pairings.
* Plan happy hours, theme nights, weekend promotions, and special events.
* Maximize average guest spending through effective upselling.
* Monitor daily sales, revenue performance, and guest footfall.

**C. Guest Experience & Customer Service**

* Deliver excellent hospitality and personalized guest service.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and resolve issues promptly.

**D. Staff Management & Training**

**E. Inventory & Cost Control**

* Manage DJ performances, live music, and entertainment activities as permitted.

* Good communication skills in English; Kannada and Hindi preferred.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and guest relationship skills.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI Performance Expectation Monthly Revenue Achieve approved sales targets Beverage Cost Maintain within approved budget Guest Satisfaction Maintain high guest review scores Inventory Variance Minimize shortages and discrepancies Staff Performance Maintain service and grooming standards Up selling Improve average revenue per guest Operational Compliance Zero major compliance violations Event Revenue Achieve event and promotional targets

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

* Presentable personality with excellent hospitality etiquette.
* Strong knowledge of premium rooftop bar operations and nightlife trends.
* Ability to manage high-volume operations and VIP guests.
* Commercially focused with strong cost-control skills.
* Capable of independently managing bar operations.
* Flexible to work evening shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

6. Salary & Benefits

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.**

We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!

As one of the UKs only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.

Were a world-class, well-funded, diverse team from over 20 different countries that believes in the product we’re building and the service we’re providing for our members. We’ve grown significantly in the last 18 months and are evolving our Marketing structure to reflect that.

**We are offering a salary of up to 2,500,000 INR for this role, plus a company cash bonus scheme and benefits**

**About the role**

We're hiring a senior product designer who puts members first and uses AI to move faster. You'll understand our members deeply, design journeys that genuinely help them, and use Claude Design to turn ideas into tested, build-ready designs in days rather than weeks.

You'll be based in India and work closely with product managers, the rest of the design team and compliance across the UK and India. Half your value is what you design and ship for members. The other half is helping the team work in an AI-first way.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the design of the member experience across their whole time with us, from sign-up to the day they leave. Work with your PM from framing the problem to a design the team can build.
* Start with members. Run regular remote research and usability tests with our UK members, listen to member calls and read feedback, and bring what you learn into every decision.
* Design for members who may be financially stretched or vulnerable, so journeys are clear, fair and easy to use. Help us deliver good outcomes under the UK's Consumer Duty.
* Design in Claude Design and produce build-ready work: clear flows, states, edge cases and specs that need few handoffs.
* Use AI to prototype and test ideas with real members quickly, and to run more experiments on our most important journeys.
* Help move the team from Figma-first to Claude Design-first, with a bias for action.
* Grow our design system, so components stay consistent and reusable.
* Raise the bar on quality: accessibility, responsive behaviour, content and the small details members notice.
* Work with compliance early so regulated copy and flows are right first time.
* Share what you learn. Pair with designers, run show and tells, and write things down.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* Five or more years in product design, with a portfolio that shows how you think and the difference your work made for customers.
* A track record of putting customers first: you've used research, data and testing to understand real needs, and changed a design because of what you learned.
* Hands-on experience designing with AI tools (ideally Claude Design), with good judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* A strong grasp of accessibility and inclusive design, built in from the start.
* Clear, kind communication. You can explain a design decision to a PM, a compliance lead and a member in the same afternoon.
* Experience working with teams in other countries and time zones

**Nice to have**

* Experience in fintech, lending or another regulated business, ideally designing for UK customers.
* Experience designing for customers in financial difficulty or other vulnerable situations.
* Running or analysing A/B tests.
* Design tokens and keeping Figma variables consistent across the system.
* Building marketing pages in Webflow or similar.  
    
  Please note that the People Team is contactable only via simran.kaur**@creditspring.co**. Unsolicited emails to other team members will not be actioned.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded **AI Product Owner** to help shape, build and scale Sandhata's AI products and solutions.

  

This role sits at the intersection of **customer needs, business strategy, AI technology and engineering delivery**. You will take ownership of the product lifecycle, from identifying market and customer problems through product definition, prioritisation, development, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

You will work closely with the **Principal Enterprise AI Architect and AI engineering teams** to translate product vision and customer requirements into clear, prioritised and achievable product capabilities.

This is not simply a backlog-management role. We are looking for someone who can **understand customers, challenge requirements, define compelling AI propositions, make prioritisation decisions and take accountability for product outcomes**.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Own product vision and roadmap**, translating Sandhata's AI strategy into clear product priorities, capabilities, releases and measurable outcomes.
* **Understand customer and market problems** through discovery sessions, stakeholder engagement, competitor analysis and continuous customer feedback.
* **Define product requirements** including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows and non-functional requirements.
* **Own and prioritise the product backlog**, balancing customer value, strategic objectives, technical dependencies, delivery effort and commercial opportunity.
* **Work closely with AI Architecture and Engineering**, ensuring business requirements are translated into viable, scalable and secure product capabilities.
* **Lead product discovery and validation**, turning ideas into prototypes, MVPs, PoCs/PoVs and ultimately production-ready products.
* **Define product success measures**, including adoption, customer value, usage, quality, commercial impact and other relevant KPIs/OKRs.
* **Own release priorities and product readiness**, ensuring capabilities meet agreed acceptance criteria and deliver the intended customer outcome.
* **Drive product adoption**, working with Sales/GTM, Marketing, Delivery and customer teams on positioning, demonstrations, onboarding and feedback.
* **Engage directly with customers and senior stakeholders**, presenting product capabilities, capturing requirements and helping shape strategic product direction.
* **Monitor the AI and competitive landscape**, identifying opportunities created by Generative AI, Agentic AI and emerging enterprise technologies.
* **Balance innovation with practicality**, making informed decisions across customer value, technical complexity, cost, risk and time-to-market.
* **Maintain strong product governance**, ensuring decisions, priorities, requirements, dependencies and outcomes are clearly documented and communicated.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position: Research Assistant**

**Summary**

The role of a Research Assistant is to support and contribute to ongoing research activities under the Mini Research Grant project titled
*“Degradation Study of Supercapacitor due to Ripple Current”*
at the School of Engineering, Chanakya University. The position involves assisting in experimental investigations, laboratory activities, data collection and analysis, and technical documentation to advance research on supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress, particularly in electric vehicle applications.

**Duration:**
6 months

**Responsibilities**

**Research and Experimental Activities:**

* Assist in conducting research activities related to supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress in electric vehicles.
* Support the development and execution of research plans, experimental procedures, and technical investigations.
* Conduct laboratory experiments involving supercapacitors, programmable power sources, electronic loads, and electrical measurement instruments.
* Assist in setting up, operating, and troubleshooting experimental hardware and laboratory equipment.
* Collect, process, analyse, and systematically document experimental data and observations.

**Technical Analysis and Documentation:**

* Conduct literature reviews on supercapacitor technology, degradation mechanisms, ripple current effects, and related power-electronic applications.
* Assist in analysing experimental results and interpreting the effects of electrical stress on supercapacitor performance and degradation.
* Prepare technical reports, research presentations, experimental records, and other project-related documentation.
* Contribute to the preparation of research papers and publications arising from the project.

**Laboratory Management and Support:**

* Assist in maintaining relevant laboratory equipment (power electronics and drives, and energy storage systems), experimental setups, and research-related records.
* Ensure proper handling and operation of electrical and electronic instruments during experimental investigations.
* Follow established laboratory safety procedures and maintain a systematic and organised research environment.

**Collaboration and Research Support:**

* Work collaboratively with the Principal Investigator, faculty members, and other internal and external research personnel to achieve the objectives of the project.
* Participate in research discussions, project reviews, and technical meetings as required.
* Contribute to other project-related research activities and responsibilities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

**Qualifications Required**

**Essential Qualifications:**

* B.Tech./B.E. in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA, subject to university norms.
* Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and work comfortably with electrical and electronic hardware setups.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* M.Tech./M.E. specialization in Power Electronics, Electric Drives, Energy Storage Systems, or a related area.
* Hands-on experience with programmable electrical sources, power converters, power supplies, electronic loads, electrical measurement instruments, or data acquisition systems.
* Experience in MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or equivalent computational tools.
* Previous research project experience or publications related to power electronics, energy storage, or electric vehicle systems.
* Ability to work independently in a research laboratory and systematically document experimental results.

**Experience Required**

* Fresh graduates may apply.
* Relevant laboratory, research, or project experience is desirable.

**Skills Required**

* Fundamentals of electrical engineering principles, power electronics, and energy storage technologies.
* Familiarity with electrical measurement instruments and hardware circuit development.
* Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent engineering simulation tools is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Dedication to maintaining laboratory safety, and research integrity.

**Duration: Initial appointment for a period of six months, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements and performance.**

jobs.title: Senior cosmetic formulator
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are establishing a new cosmetic manufacturing facility in Noida and are looking for an experienced
**Cosmetic Formulator and R&D Leader**
to build and lead our formulation and product development team.

We are looking for someone who has hands-on industry experience in cosmetic formulation, with a proven track record of developing products that have successfully gone to market. The ideal candidate should have experience working with existing commercial SKUs, understand the entire product development cycle, and possess the technical creativity to develop innovative, high-performance formulations rather than simply replicate existing products.

This role will be responsible for building our formulation capabilities from the ground up, developing new product formulations, optimizing existing formulations, establishing laboratory processes, and leading a team of chemists to create differentiated cosmetic products.

Key Responsibilities1. Formulation Development & Innovation

* Develop innovative, high-performance formulations across skincare, haircare, body care and other cosmetic categories.
* Create unique formulations with differentiated textures, sensory experiences, ingredient combinations and performance benefits.
* Develop products inspired by global market trends while creating original formulations with a distinct competitive advantage.
* Formulate creams, serums, gels, lotions, sunscreens, cleansers, toners, emulsions, masks and other cosmetic products.
* Work with advanced active ingredients, functional ingredients, delivery systems, emulsifiers, preservatives and rheology modifiers.
* Troubleshoot formulation challenges and continuously improve stability, efficacy, aesthetics and product performance.

2. Commercial Product & Market Experience

* Bring practical experience with cosmetic products that have already been commercialized and are available in the market.
* Understand the journey from laboratory formulation to pilot batch, manufacturing scale-up and commercial production.
* Develop formulations that are commercially viable, scalable, stable and cost-effective.
* Evaluate competing products, ingredient technologies and global cosmetic trends to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Translate product briefs and consumer requirements into technically sound formulations.

3. R&D Laboratory Setup & Operations

* Establish and organize the formulation laboratory at our new manufacturing facility.
* Identify laboratory equipment, instruments, raw materials, testing requirements and operational workflows.
* Establish formulation SOPs, documentation systems, batch records and laboratory protocols.
* Build a systematic product development process from concept and prototype through validation and production handover.
* Develop a structured raw material database, formulation library and product development pipeline.

4. Stability, Testing & Quality

* Design and execute stability testing, compatibility testing and accelerated stability studies.
* Evaluate product parameters including pH, viscosity, texture, appearance, spreadability, sensory properties and performance.
* Troubleshoot issues related to separation, oxidation, discoloration, fragrance instability, preservative efficacy and packaging compatibility.
* Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure formulations meet applicable cosmetic regulations and safety requirements.

5. Manufacturing & Scale-Up

* Transfer formulations from laboratory scale to pilot and commercial manufacturing scale.
* Work closely with production teams to establish manufacturing processes, mixing parameters, temperatures, homogenization requirements, addition sequences and processing times.
* Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and ensure reproducibility between laboratory batches and commercial batches.
* Optimize formulations for manufacturing efficiency, yield, consistency and cost.

6. Team Leadership

* Recruit, mentor, train and lead a team of formulation chemists and laboratory personnel.
* Set R&D priorities, timelines, project milestones and development targets.
* Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, innovation, experimentation and accountability.
* Review formulations, technical work and development progress while ensuring the team consistently delivers quality results.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline.
* **Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on experience in cosmetic formulation and product development.**
* Strong preference for candidates currently or previously working with established cosmetic manufacturers, skincare brands, third-party manufacturing companies or product development laboratories.
* Proven experience developing formulations that have successfully launched commercially and are currently sold in the market.
* Strong expertise in formulation chemistry, ingredient functionality, emulsification, rheology, preservation, stability and cosmetic product design.
* Experience in commercial manufacturing scale-up and production troubleshooting.
* Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading a formulation/R&D team is highly desirable.
* Ability to independently develop formulations rather than relying entirely on supplier-provided base formulas.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on formulator who is equally comfortable working in a laboratory and leading a team.

The ideal candidate:

* Has personally developed multiple successful commercial cosmetic SKUs.
* Has a strong portfolio of products they have formulated or helped bring to market.
* Has the ability to develop genuinely differentiated formulations and innovative textures.
* Is knowledgeable about new ingredients, actives, formulation technologies and global beauty trends.
* Can build a formulation laboratory and R&D team from scratch.
* Understands commercial realities including raw material costs, margins, manufacturing feasibility and scalability.
* Is proactive, entrepreneurial and capable of taking ownership of product development.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to lead and build the formulation R&D function at a new cosmetic manufacturing facility.
* Freedom to experiment, innovate and develop proprietary formulations.
* Access to laboratory infrastructure, raw materials and product development resources.
* Leadership role with direct influence over the company's product portfolio and innovation strategy.
* Opportunity to build and lead your own formulation team.
* Monetary incentive

Application Requirements

Candidates should share:

* Updated CV detailing formulation and R&D experience.
* List of cosmetic products/SKUs they have developed or contributed to that have been commercially launched.
* Categories and formulation technologies they specialize in.
* Previous employers and nature of their responsibilities.
* Experience in laboratory setup, team leadership and manufacturing scale-up.

**Candidates without hands-on commercial cosmetic formulation experience will not be considered.**

jobs.description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

jobs.description:
**PROFESSOR COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING (CSE)**

**Specialization:** Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms & Graph Theory

**Department:** Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Head of the Department / Principal  
 **Position:** Professor

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To provide academic leadership and deliver quality teaching and research in Computer Science & Engineering, with specialization in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.

The Professor will be responsible for teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, guiding research scholars, mentoring faculty members, promoting research and innovation, and contributing to the academic and research development of the department.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
* Prepare course plans, lecture materials, assignments, tutorials and assessment methodologies.
* Teach machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation and predictive modelling.
* Explain data collection, preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization and analytical techniques.
* Teach algorithm design techniques, computational complexity, optimization and problem-solving methods.
* Explain graph structures, graph algorithms, network analysis and graph-based applications.
* Conduct laboratory sessions, programming assignments, technical demonstrations and project-based learning activities wherever applicable.
* Evaluate student performance and provide academic guidance and mentoring.
* Implement Outcome-Based Education (OBE), including Course Outcomes (COs), assessment and attainment analysis.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and the development of effective teaching and learning practices.

**B. Research & Development**

* Conduct research in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design, Graph Theory and related emerging technologies.
* Publish quality research papers in reputed peer-reviewed journals and international conferences.
* Apply for funded research projects, grants and consultancy opportunities from government agencies and industry.
* Guide Ph.D. research scholars, postgraduate dissertations and undergraduate research projects, subject to university recognition and eligibility.
* Encourage interdisciplinary research, innovation, patents and industry collaboration.
* Establish research collaborations with reputed academic institutions and research organizations.
* Contribute to the development of research laboratories and departmental research activities.

**C. Academic Leadership & Departmental Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior faculty members and support their teaching, research and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development, academic planning and continuous improvement.
* Participate in Board of Studies, academic committees and institutional development activities.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, conferences, technical events and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Support NBA, NAAC, AICTE and other accreditation and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to departmental academic administration, research planning and institutional development.
* Promote industry-academia collaboration and student skill development initiatives.

**3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**A. Machine Learning**

* Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Feature Engineering and Feature Selection
* Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
* Model Training, Validation, Testing and Evaluation
* Ensemble Learning Techniques
* Predictive Modelling and Performance Optimization
* Python and Machine Learning Libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

**B. Data Analytics**

* Data Collection, Cleaning and Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
* Data Visualization and Interpretation
* Python / R Programming
* SQL and Database Management
* Data Analytics Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
* Business Intelligence Tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent
* Predictive Analytics and Data-Driven Decision-Making

**C. Design and Analysis of Algorithms**

* Data Structures and Algorithm Design
* Time and Space Complexity Analysis
* Asymptotic Notations
* Sorting and Searching Algorithms
* Divide and Conquer Techniques
* Greedy Algorithms
* Dynamic Programming
* Backtracking and Branch and Bound
* Graph Algorithms
* NP-Completeness and Computational Complexity
* Algorithm Optimization and Performance Analysis

**D. Graph Theory**

* Graph Structures and Representations
* Directed and Undirected Graphs
* Graph Traversal Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
* Connectivity, Trees and Spanning Trees
* Shortest Path Algorithms
* Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms
* Graph Coloring and Matching
* Network Flow and Graph Optimization
* Graph-Based Modelling and Network Analysis
* Applications of Graph Theory in Computer Science

**4. REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

**Undergraduate Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Postgraduate Qualification**

* M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Doctoral Qualification**

* Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science or a relevant allied discipline.

**Preferred Teaching and Research Specializations**

*Educational qualifications and eligibility shall be subject to applicable AICTE, UGC, Osmania University and institutional recruitment norms.*

**5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Teaching, research and professional experience as prescribed under applicable AICTE/UGC and university norms for appointment to the position of Professor.

Role Objective:

To execute hands-on laboratory experiments for the formulation development of sterile liquid injectables, drug-device combination products, and lyophilized formulations. This role focuses on day-to-day experimental execution, cycle optimization, device compatibility evaluation, and operational troubleshooting under the guidance of senior team members to ensure smooth project progression. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Formulation Execution: Conduct routine laboratory experiments to develop stable, robust sterile liquid injectable dosage forms and troubleshoot technical issues during development.
* Drug-Device Testing: Perform compatibility, functional testing, and quality evaluations for drug-device combination products in alignment with regulatory expectations.
* Lyophilization Support: Execute freeze-drying runs for peptides, proteins, and small molecules, aiding in cycle development, optimization, and characterization.
* Laboratory Operations: Maintain analytical and processing equipment, document experimental protocols, keep meticulous laboratory notebooks, and draft standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Scale-Up Assistance: Assist senior scientists in technology transfer activities, batch manufacturing records (BMR) preparation, and pilot batch execution.
* Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to cGMP guidelines, safety standards, and internal quality systems in all daily laboratory activities.

  
STAKEHOLDER INTERACTION

Type of Interaction: Internal

* Interaction with: Senior Scientists, Analytical R&D, Quality Assurance, and Packaging Development.
* Nature of Interaction: Daily routine work alignment, reporting experimental results, sample handover for analytical testing, and technical data discussion.

Type of Interaction: External

* Interaction with: Raw material suppliers and analytical/equipment vendors.
* Nature of Interaction: Procurement of lab samples/reagents, routine equipment calibration support, and gathering technical product specifications.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Professional Experience and Relevant Skills

* Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant hands-on experience in sterile injectable formulation R&D.
* Technical Expertise:

1. Operational understanding of aseptic processing techniques, sterile compounding, filtration, and lyo cycle monitoring.
2. Basic familiarity with ICH guidelines, GLP/cGMP protocols, and device compatibility metrics.

* Skills:

1. Hands-on formulation development of sterile liquid injectables and basic troubleshooting capabilities.
2. Exposure to drug-device combination product testing, device functionality, and compatibility setups.
3. Practical experience operating lyophilizers and supporting freeze-drying cycle optimization for small molecules, peptides, or proteins.

Academic Qualifications & Certifications

**This position reports to:**

Engineering Manager

**Mission of the Role**

Are you interested in cybersecurity governance and motivated to be part of a global company transforming the industry with advanced technology? ABB is looking for a **Cyber Security Specialist** to join our **Automation Engineering and Service organization** in Machine Automation.

New European Union regulations set rules for how applications must be engineered and delivered. In this role, you will define the first cybersecurity governance and security guidelines for these applications. You will be the primary contact for cybersecurity matters. If you have experience in GRC, IEC 62443 and ISO/IEC 27001, and you are ready to turn regulations into practical controls, this opportunity is for you!

  

**Work model:** Hybrid

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define, maintain and continuously improve the cybersecurity governance framework for global automation engineering and services.
* Translate ABB requirements, customer obligations, regulations and standards (such as IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001 and NIS2) into practical controls, processes and responsibilities.
* Coordinate cybersecurity risk assessments, treatment, risk acceptance by designated risk owners, escalation and exception management. Maintain risk and compliance reporting.
* Define the secure development lifecycle, decision rights, RACI models and minimum requirements for engineering projects, service activities and lifecycle changes.
* Coordinate compliance assessments, audits and corrective actions. Develop reusable policies, templates, checklists and control mappings.
* Monitor regulatory and standards developments, including NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and coordinate the required governance updates.
* Support and advise customers on cybersecurity requirements and help them apply practical security measures in their automation applications.
* Align with Product Cyber Security, R&D, IT, Quality, Legal & Integrity and regional organizations, providing practical guidance on governance, risk and compliance.

  

**Requirements**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Practical experience in cybersecurity, risk and compliance, including direct technical security work.

* Ability to structure risk decisions, control frameworks, exceptions, audit evidence and KPIs, and to translate complex requirements into practical guidance.
* Solid technical writing, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with a pragmatic, risk-based working style and the ability to work without formal authority.
* Fluent English.

  

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience in industrial automation, OT or other industrial environments.

  

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to be part of a global company engaged in large-scale industrial projects.
* The chance to build the first cybersecurity governance guidelines of this kind for the organization.
* Collaborative environment with continuous learning, advanced technologies and a supportive development culture.
* Growth possibilities within a solid technical career path inside ABB.
* Hybrid work model.

  

**About ABB's Machine Automation Division**

The Machine Automation division of ABB **(B&R Industrial Automation)** works with automation engineering and service teams and customers worldwide. Our teams develop solutions that support digital transformation and improve operational performance for our customers.

  

AUSTRIA: The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is 4.472,11 EUR monthly for a full-time position as of November 2026. But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience .

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**E-Commerce Manager**

**| Online Business & Marketplace Operations**

**Role Details**

**Designation**

**E-Commerce Manager**

**Department**

E-Commerce / Online Business

Lower Parel

**Experience**

3-7 years

work from office

**Working Days / Hours**

Monday to Saturday (Any 2 Saturdays off)

10:00 AM to 06:30 PM

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketplace Business & Account Management**

* Own day-to-day operations and account coordination across Myntra, Nykaa D, Purplle and Zepto.
* Maintain effective working relationships with marketplace KAMs and functional contacts across cataloging, marketing, supply chain and claims.
* Track marketplace issues, resolve operational blockers and escalate pending commercial, listing, PO or supply-chain matters to the relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain marketplace-specific trackers, workflow sheets, reference files, monthly plans and communication threads.

**2. Sales Reporting, Analysis & Business Tracking**

* Monitor sales performance and update the daily sales tracker where applicable, including daily Zepto sales and Myntra sales feeds, and weekly Purplle sales tracking.
* Prepare and update monthly sales reports, including item-code/SKU-wise and L3/category-wise contribution.
* Update the CTS Google Sheet and account workings on an excluding-GST basis, coordinating with the relevant sales and accounts stakeholders.
* Track sales against agreed plans and targets; identify gaps and share performance updates with internal stakeholders.

**3. Catalog, Listing, Assortment & Product Lifecycle**

* Manage marketplace cataloging and listing workflows, including Myntra listing templates and style-ID master updates.
* Ensure the Myntra master file is maintained with EAN, style ID, SKU name, MRP and active/inactive status, and shared monthly as required.
* Keep Nykaa D catalog information aligned with Nykaa.com and coordinate quarterly SKU additions after reviewing tail SKUs.
* Conduct quarterly SKU/NPI reviews for Zepto and maintain assortment additions and discontinuations.
* Monitor listing health, product visibility, offer display and pricing on marketplace apps/websites.

**4. Pricing, Discounts, Offers & Promotional Planning**

* Check Myntra portal discounts three times daily and flag any displayed discount that breaches the applicable approved ceiling.
* Maintain discount and price-off files, upload approved discounts in the relevant portals and align offers with marketplace POCs and calendars.
* Maintain Purplle BAU and IHB offer structures and coordinate discount alignment with the Purplle POC.
* Manage Zepto discount uploads using the approved Zepto Master and ensure the on-invoice discount and additional discount are handled within approved policy.
* Coordinate with the Brand Manager and relevant teams on annual/periodic Joint Business Plan (JBP) targets, marketing plans and claim slabs for Nykaa D.

**5. Purchase Orders, Inventory & Supply Chain**

* Track marketplace POs and ensure they are received, reviewed and actioned within the platforms operating cadence.
* Reconcile inventory against open POs weekly for Myntra and Purplle, and follow up on shortages, pending orders and delivery issues.
* Coordinate Nykaa D weekly POs and obtain month-start stock-on-hand (SOH) and sales reports from the KAM.
* Coordinate Zeptos twice-weekly POs and resolve supply-chain or lead-time issues with the internal supply-chain team and marketplace SCM contacts.
* Follow up on POs for newly listed Myntra SKUs within the SOP-defined 1520-day timeline.

**6. Marketing, Visibility & Performance Advertising Coordination**

* Coordinate marketplace visibility plans and campaign requirements with marketplace marketing POCs.
* Work with the Performance Marketing/Ads team on PLA and PREP activity, as applicable; ensure budgets are management-approved.
* Close and review Zepto PLA visibility monthly and pursue FOC on-site visibility against PLA investment where applicable.
* Align monthly visibility on the Superstore by Nykaa app and coordinate relevant Purplle visibility/PREP plans and settlements.
* Maintain marketing decks, discounting files, listing guidelines, NPI files and monthly plans.

**7. Commercials, Claims, Settlements & Reconciliation**

* Verify marketing-investment and discount debit notes (DNs), claims and supporting workings before approval/sign-off, as applicable to each marketplace.
* Coordinate with MKKLs online and Accounts-Receivable teams for discount and advertising settlement checks.
* Track Nykaa D JBP claims against pre-agreed slabs and coordinate applicable visibility, discount and claim settlements.
* Coordinate Purplle visibility, MOQ, discount and PREP settlements with the marketplace POC; flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Coordinate the applicable 1% West Bengal TOT claim with the Accounts team for Nykaa D.
* Maintain an audit-ready record of approved discounts, claims, bills, DNs, settlement status and supporting files.

jobs.title: R&D Digital Platforms Asst Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**   
   

As a PD specification writer, the role requires ensuring that the necessary criteria and requirements in building the specification of ING and Non INGs (Excluding Packaging Label) are met. This role will drive the legacy specification migration to SAP initially and provide support to PepsiCo Product Developers on new ING NON-ING PD Spec development to ensure they comply with the standards and requirements Post System rollout in the sector.

  
 **Responsibilities**   
   

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand the PepsiCo PLM and SW ways of working in legacy systems (offline) and in SAP including Global Ingredient Standard and Supplier Standard and become proficient in the CAST Program and IT Applications associated.
* Drive accurate migration of Legacy Specs (ING and Non ING) in SAP systems and validate with regional teamsPre Go live on CAST.
* Collaborate with Regional teams to review and update ING Non-ING specifications in line with the regular spec renewal dates.
* Collaborate with Regional Cross Functional Teams and external resources to develop ING and Non-ING specifications (Excluding Label Packaging) that are clear, concise, and accurate to be handed over to run operations- Post Go Live on CAST.
* Ensure all requests are processed, documented, and delivered within defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
* Identify potential areas for process improvements to make recommendations to RD Leadership for continuous improvement.
* Raise necessary CRs on behalf of sector R D teams when needed and aligned.

**ING Specs**  :

* Work with and provide guidance to suppliers in completing the requirements of the specification through the completion of relevant tools i.e. ISSQ, in the following Key areas:

* Ingredient Composition
* All Chemical, physical and other parameter requirement.
* Claims/Compliance related with QA/FS
* Food safety Requirements
* Allergen
* Test method and limit of for FS and Performance parameters
* Ingredient Micro sensitive assessment.
* Other Spec General information

* Validate correct migration of data to the Global Ingredient Specification system, includes review of the information and supporting documents/evidence collected from the supplier.
* Work with Functional approver to review and align the specifications created/updated. Communicate with Operations and vendors for acceptance on specification change as needed. Coordinate uploads with SDSA teams.
* Work with Functional Approvers (Regulatory, Quality, Food Safety, Product Development, Analytical and Micro), and facilitate engagement with the relevant stakeholders like GP, SQA and QC for enrichment of specifications as per Global business workflows.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards.
* Collaborate with LiSU to assess impact on higher level specs if any and manage with regional partners.
* Upload all paperwork (i.e., Supplier Specs) and materials qualifications into the SAP system and track workflow.
* Manage Supplier relationships and serve as point of contact to gather information/data needed to build specifications; complete timely follow-ups to keep the process moving to completion.

**Non ING Specs (Scope- Formula, Process, FGE):**

* Collaborate with and provide guidance to regional PD, TDC and Packaging teams in completing the requirements of the Non-ING specs through the completion of relevant tools- AMESA Spec Request Form PLM Templates.
* Align ER release per the project classification (Innovation, Productivity, TBS, Ingredient Change etc).
* Digitize the Non ING specs accurately per the information received from PDs and review ER progress against the agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with PD,TDC, Pkg partners to ensure ER closure on time.
* Collaborate with SDSA, RA Pkg partners to ensure the necessary uploads in R D repositories.
* Escalate the risks/challenges faced (if any) well in time with the stakeholders through the progress on ER(s) for the projects.
* Maintain and update existing specs to ensure compliance with standards

**System associated activities:**

- Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of systems related to creation of specifications (e.g. SAP) as may

be required. Report gaps, roadblocks or findings and support on finding solutions and help facilitate closure with

IT SMEs

  
 **Qualifications**   
   

* Bachelors degree in Food Engineering, Food Safety, Food Technology, Food Science and Microbiology, or adjacent subjects. MS is desired.
* Min. 2-3 years of experience on Regulatory, QA/QC, Food Analytical experience or other Food related FMCG in a technical role; 1-2 years of which on Product Development or Specification Writing.
* Well-versed on Microsoft Office and Excel.
* Effective communication skills, both verbal (i.e. presentation, conference calls) and written (i.e. reports, e-mails) in English.
* Confident and able to speak or present to senior leaders when needed.
* Learning agility, self-motivation and desire for continuous self-improvement.
* Team player and works well with cross-functional, cross-regional and cross-cultural teams.
* Can work independently and has initiative for problem solving

jobs.description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands **mCaffeine & Hyphen**. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is Indias first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEPs mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases.

**Come, join the pack!**

  

**Job Summary :** We're looking for a **Lead - R&D (Hair Care)** to own formulation and development for our Hair Care portfolio — shampoos, conditioners, hair masks, hair oils, hair serums and scalp care. This is a senior, hands-on role for a formulator who has built and launched multiple hair care products and understands surfactant chemistry, conditioning science and scalp health in depth. You'll drive new launches, upgrade our top sellers, guide a small team, and be the technical expert for everything hair and scalp.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* End-to-End Formulation: Formulate shampoos, conditioners, masks, hair oils, leave-in serums, and scalp/hair-fall treatments from concept brief through commercial launch, tailored to Indian hair types, water hardness, and climate.
* Technical Expertise: Build mild, high-performing surfactant systems; develop conditioning treatments for frizz control and shine; create non-sticky oils/serums; and formulate compliant anti-dandruff and hair-growth solutions using actives like caffeine and peptides.
* Testing, Stability & Compliance: Oversee stability, compatibility, and preservative challenge studies; manage performance (tress/salon) and external clinical claims testing; and maintain technical dossiers aligned with CDSCO/BIS standards.
* Product Upgrades & Cost Optimization: Reformulate top-selling SKUs to boost performance and sensorials, drive cost savings via formula/process improvements, and build an alternate ingredient library to de-risk supply.
* Scale-Up & Leadership: Lead tech transfer and first-batch supervision with contract manufacturers, mentor 1–3 junior formulators, partner cross-functionally for on-time launches, and scout global hair care trends.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Cosmetic Science/Technology, Chemistry, Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science/Technology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, or related field
* 7–10 years of hands-on cosmetics/personal care R&D experience, with hair care as the primary focus
* Proven track record of personally formulating and launching shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, masks and/or scalp care products
* Strong command of surfactant chemistry, conditioning science, rheology/thickening systems, preservation and stability troubleshooting
* Experience with hair performance testing and hair fall / anti-dandruff claims substantiation
* Working knowledge of CDSCO/BIS regulations for hair care, including limits on anti-dandruff and other regulated actives
* High ownership and comfort with pace and ambiguity in a start-up / fast-scaling D2C environment

  

**Contact us:**

Careers – career@mcaffeine.com / aysha.dass@mcaffeine.com

jobs.title: School Teacher
jobs.description:
**About Christel House: Christel House is a non-profit organization specializing in educating and transforming the lives**

**of impoverished children around the world. Towards this end, Christel House schools provide a robust K-12 education,**

**nutritious meals, a strong character development program, college & career support, and family assistance.**

  

**Job Title: Primary School Teacher**

  

**Job Overview: As a primary school teacher, you are responsible for nurturing the academic, social, and**

**emotional development of young children. You create a positive learning environment where students can**

**explore, learn, and grow. The role involves planning and delivering lessons, assessing student progress,**

**and collaborating with colleagues and parents to support each child's educational journey.**

  

**Main Roles &**

**Responsibilities: Specific duties and responsibilities of the Primary School Teacher will**

**include as follows, but will not be limited to the following**

**1. Curriculum Development and Implementation:**

  

**• Plan and prepare courses, schemes of work, and individual lesson plans tailored to students'**

**needs.**

**• Integrate subjects like EVS, literacy, and maths to create a comprehensive learning**

**experience.**

**• Employ diverse teaching methods such as storytelling, educational play, and media to**

**engage students effectively.**

**• Organize field trips aligned with the curriculum to provide hands-on learning experiences.**

**• Foster values and independent thinking among students through experiential learning.**

  

**2. Student Assessment and Support:**

  

**• Assess individual student progress through formative and summative assessments and**

**update the scores on the student information system (SIS) and Share point.**

**• Communicate with parents during parent-teacher meetings to understand students'**

**backgrounds and update parents on their progress.**

**• Analyse and provide oral/ written reports for FA & SA data along with Instructional Coach**

**and D.P to support student learning and growth.**

**• Collaborate and work with R.T.I ( Response to Intervention) and co-curricular teachers to**

**refine and implement an integrated curriculum.**

  

**3. Classroom Management and Environment:**

  

**• Ensure classrooms are safe, positive, and nurturing environments conducive to learning.**

**• Contribute to creating attractive displays throughout the class that align with the**

**curriculum.**

**• Model appropriate behaviour and communication while enforcing school rules and values.**

**• Supervise students during transitions, including walking with them to and from the dining**

**hall and during dispersal to ensure their safety and well-being.**

  

**4. Other Important tasks:**

**• Serve as a homeroom/ class teacher with responsibility, for the day-to-day pastoral care of**

**students.**

**• Attend meetings such as staff and departmental meetings.**

**• Carry out supervisory duties at assembly/lunch times.**

**• Attend workshops and support student functions outside of the regular school day.**

**• Serve on House duties and Committees, as required.**

**• Act as a substitution teacher for other teachers in the absence of a teacher or as per the need.**

**• Maintain regular attendance during all scheduled school days .**

**• Perform any additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.**

**• Create supplementary resources like charts and worksheets to enhance classroom learning.**

**• Participate in invigilation and evaluation duties as per the requirements.**

**• Prepare students for events like Sports days, Class assembly, Annual days, and STEM & Literary**

**Fests.**

**• Complete appraisal documents and submit them to the immediate Supervisor as part of**

**professional development requirements.**

**• Reflect on teaching practices and contribute to school-wide reviews of policies and aims.**

**• Keep accurate records of attendance, grades, and other relevant data.**

  

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

**• Bachelors Degree/Diploma degree in education**

**• Prior experience as a primary school teacher (preferable)**

**• Excellent understanding of the principles of child development and educational methods to teach**

**primary students.**

**• Excellent communication, instructional and storytelling skills .**

**• Well versed on how to use Microsoft Word, Excel and PPT.**

**• Patient, friendly and reliable**

jobs.description:
This is a cGMP and FSSC 22000 certified contract manufacturer specializing in nutrition, protein, energy, granola, and clean-label food bars. Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.
* **Process & Line Management:** Supervise specialized food processing operations including slab/sheet-and-cut, low-pressure cold extrusion, baking, chocolate/compound enrobing, and primary/secondary automated packaging.
* **Quality & Food Safety Compliance:** Enforce cGMP, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and FSSAI guidelines on the shop floor. Oversee critical control points including inline metal detection and check-weighing systems.
* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, train, and manage shift supervisors, machine operators, and floor workers; oversee shift scheduling, attendance, and shop-floor discipline.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance (QA/QC), R&D (for new product trials and tech transfers), Maintenance, and Supply Chain/Stores teams to resolve bottlenecks smoothly.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain accurate daily production logs, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics, batch manufacturing records (BMR), and audit documentation for client and regulatory inspections.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.
