**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Purpose of the Role**

* Support the development and data generation for registration of crop-protection products through high-quality analytical testing and product chemistry studies.
* The role requires hands-on laboratory work, strong data integrity and strict adherence to OECD GLP, HSE and quality standards

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform analytical and product chemistry testing of technical materials, raw materials, intermediates, by-products and formulations.
* Use and maintain analytical instruments including GC, HPLC and spectroscopic equipment.
* Conduct formulation and physical-property studies, including pH, density, viscosity, surface tension and suspensibility.
* Plan laboratory work, monitor and interpret storage-stability studies.
* Produce accurate, traceable raw data, calculations and reports in line with SOPs and GLP requirements.
* Support the Study Director or Line manager for product-development, registration, manufacturing and supply-chain projects; communicate findings clearly to study leadership.
* Follow safe laboratory practices, good housekeeping and proactive risk management.

**Skills and Behaviours**

* Knowledge of OECD GLP, data integrity, laboratory safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Proactive, independent, and solution-focused approach.
* Experienced study personnel in GLP test facility.
* Strong presentation, interpersonal, and technical-writing skills

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* PhD or master’s degree in chemistry or a related discipline; Analytical Chemistry preferred.
* At least 1 year’s relevant experience with a PhD, or 3 years with a master’s degree.
* Experience in agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals Industries or a GLP-certified CRO.
* Practical experience with GC, HPLC, spectroscopy and computerised data systems.
* Working knowledge of OECD GLP, laboratory safety and chemical-hazard management.
* Detail-oriented, organised and able to deliver reliable results within agreed timelines.
* Collaborative, adaptable and keen to build technical expertise in a cross-functional R&D environment.

**Job Title:** Production Manager- Sanitary Pads & Hygiene Products

**Location:** Pune

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Department:** Production/ Operations

**Reports To:** Managing Director

**CTC:** 10-15 LPA

**Direct reports**: Production, Maintenance & Engineering, Quality Assurance / Quality Control, Planning & Stores, EHS, Plant HR/Admin (via functional heads)

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Production volume vs plan, OEE and line efficiency

* Material yield and wastage percentage

* Cost per unit and conversion cost vs budget

* Quality metrics: customer complaints, rejection rate, audit findings

* On-time delivery and order fulfilment

* Safety performance (LTIFR, incidents) and compliance record

* Attrition, training hours and talent development

jobs.title: Executive - Product Development
jobs.description:
**Designation:** EXECUTIVE
  
**Location:** India UTTAR PRADESH Noida
  
**Group:** DS Group
  
**Entity:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited
  
**SBU:** Dharampal Satyapal Foods Limited
  
**Department:** PRODUCT AND TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT
  
**Function:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT LAB
  

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.
* Accuracy and consistency of laboratory formulations.
* Successful execution of assigned laboratory trials.
* Accuracy and completeness of trial documentation.
* Effective management of laboratory raw materials and inventory.
* Compliance with laboratory hygiene, safety and housekeeping standards.
* Responsiveness to internal sample development requirements.

### **7. Nature of Role**

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. The incumbent will be primarily stationed at the NPD laboratory and will support factory/pilot and factory trials as and when required.

**Skills:**

New Product Development

Food Science

Food Technology

Lab handling

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

**Overview**
**Overview:**
The Senior Research Associate independently develops renovation and innovation products from formulation and laboratory evaluation through application validation, factory trials, scale-up, and transfer to manufacturing. This hands-on role requires regular work in Kemin and external laboratories and the ability to plan and execute factory trials at Kemin’s manufacturing facility. The role serves as the product owner for assigned products from concept to launch.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Renovation and Innovation Projects**

* Lead assigned renovation and innovation projects, or defined R&D workstreams within larger projects, from technical brief through formulation, laboratory evaluation, application validation, factory trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, and technical launch readiness.
* Define the technical scope, hypotheses, Critical to Quality requirements, success criteria, milestones, risks, resources, and deliverables with the project sponsor and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain current project plans and communicate progress, technical decisions, dependencies, risks, delays, and recovery actions before milestones are missed.
* Remain accountable for assigned technical deliverables until agreed acceptance criteria are achieved, required documentation is completed, and outstanding technical issues are formally transferred to the accountable function Perform Hands-On Laboratory and Application Work.
* Spend significant working time conducting experiments and application trials in Kemin laboratories and, when required, at external laboratories, customer facilities, partner facilities, and manufacturing sites.
* Independently formulate prototypes and conduct efficacy, stability, analytical, application-performance, and product-packaging compatibility evaluations.
* Design and execute robust experiments using appropriate controls, replication, statistical methods, and predefined acceptance criteria.
* Maintain complete and traceable records of protocols, raw data, observations, deviations, results, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Ensure laboratory, pilot, and production experiments are documented in accordance with applicable procedures and PIP requirements. The PIP Manual requires these experiments to be recorded in laboratory notebooks and white paper Plan and Run Manufacturing Trials.
* Independently plan, coordinate, and lead on-site factory trials at Kemin’s Gummidipoondi manufacturing facility.
* Establish trial objectives, protocols, material requirements, process parameters, sampling plans, Critical to Quality measures, and acceptance criteria before each trial.
* Work on-site with Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other relevant functions during trial execution.
* Lead technical troubleshooting, collect and analyze trial data, document conclusions, and ensure agreed follow-up actions are completed.
* Recommend whether a product is ready for reformulation, further testing, repeat trials, scale-up, manufacturing transfer, or technical launch readiness.

**Manage R&D Deliverables within PIP**

* Serve as the R&D Project Manager for assigned projects, working collaboratively with the Product Manager and the wider Product Innovation Process team.
* Develop and maintain the research plan and ensure assigned R&D activities and documentation are completed according to the applicable PIP stage and agreed schedule.
* Provide complete and timely technical data, white papers, trial reports, risk assessments, Critical to Quality evidence, packaging recommendations, and manufacturing-transfer information for PIP reviews and gate decisions.
* Proactively identify technical gaps, coordinate actions with relevant functions, and resolve outstanding requirements before requesting progression to the next PIP stage.
* Maintain accurate PIP documentation in the designated company project-management system.
* Support scale-up, launch, and post-launch technical follow-up, including additional efficacy, stability, quality, application, or manufacturing work when required.

**Generate Reliable Data and Technical Recommendations**

* Collect, analyze, interpret, and document research and trial data independently, ensuring traceability from raw data to conclusion.
* Apply fit-for-purpose analytical and application methods and confirm that instruments, standards, controls, and methods are suitable for use.
* Review data generated by interns/trainees, identify gaps, and determine whether additional work is required.
* Convert findings into clear recommendations on formulation, efficacy, stability, application performance, packaging, manufacturing feasibility, technical risks, and next steps.
* Use appropriate statistical methods and approved digital and AI-enabled tools to identify trends and improve the speed and quality of technical analysis and decision support.
* Apply independent scientific judgment when reviewing AI-assisted outputs and verify the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of information before use.

**Evaluate and Recommend Packaging**

* Evaluate and recommend appropriate packaging formats, materials, pack sizes, and technical specifications based on product compatibility, stability, customer application, storage, transportation, regulatory requirements, cost, and manufacturing capability.
* Plan and execute packaging compatibility and stability studies, and coordinate packaging trials when required.
* Work collaboratively with the Product Manager, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to test and finalize packaging through the applicable PIP stage-gate process.
* Include approved packaging specifications, compatibility evidence, storage requirements, and handling instructions in the technical transfer package.

**Build Scientific, Product, and Digital Expertise**

* Review relevant scientific literature, patents, competitor technologies, market developments, and customer requirements.
* Translate scientific and industry knowledge into technical hypotheses and potential renovation or innovation opportunities.
* Use approved AI and digital tools to improve literature reviews, patent-search preparation, experimental planning, data analysis, technical writing, and knowledge management.
* Protect confidential, proprietary, customer, and personal information when using AI or other digital tools and comply with applicable company policies.
* Do not rely on AI-generated content as a substitute for scientific evidence, qualified technical judgment, required approvals, or documented experimental work.
* Serve as the technical subject-matter expert for assigned products and maintain accurate, current, and reusable product knowledge.
* Prepare and review technical reports, protocols, white papers, presentations, internal publications, product guidance, and training materials.

**Drive Cross-Functional Commercialization**

* Proactively build and maintain effective working relationships with the PIP team and key functions, including Operations, Manufacturing, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Technical Service, and global R&D.
* Work collaboratively throughout the PIP process to align technical development with customer needs, product cost, commercial potential, packaging requirements, regulatory requirements, manufacturing feasibility, and launch priorities.

**1. Position Purpose**

To own and grow company's branded business outside India across all international regions. The Head – International Business (Brands) sets the international brand and market strategy, builds and leads the regional team, expands the distributor network, opens new countries, and is accountable for secondary sales, stock health, new product introductions and the overall international revenue, profitability and forecast.

This is a business-building role, not an export-coordination role. The incumbent must be comfortable working directly with distributor owners, KOLs and institutional buyers, and equally comfortable reviewing numbers and presenting performance to the Management.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategy and Business Planning**

* Define the international brand strategy, country prioritisation and market-entry roadmap aligned with the Company's overall business plan.
* Prepare annual and monthly regional and country business plans, budgets, forecasts and pipeline, and ensure their achievement.
* Take full P&L ownership of international brands business: revenue, pricing, margin, trade terms and receivables, in coordination with Finance.
* Evaluate new market opportunities across private market, hospitals, institutions and government tenders.

**B. Distributor Network and Market Development**

* Develop secondary sales and product movement through existing distributors and their sales teams.

* Identify, evaluate, appoint and, where required, exit distributors; negotiate distribution agreements and commercial terms.
* Open new countries and expand company's presence beyond existing markets.
* Activate and improve the productivity of distributor sales and marketing teams through training, joint field work and review mechanisms.

**C. Brand, Product and Portfolio**

* Own international brand positioning, brand plans and promotional, digital and scientific initiatives with distributor marketing teams.
* Drive new product and new pack introductions and ensure successful market launches; introduction and upselling of new formulations.
* Gather market requirements and competitor intelligence and feed these to R&D, Regulatory and Supply Chain for new formulations, pack sizes and product development.
* Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market trends and emerging clinical nutrition opportunities.

**D. KOL and Scientific Engagement**

* Build and oversee KOL networks across assigned countries.
* Plan and ensure execution of RTMs, CNEs, scientific meetings and other healthcare professional engagement programmes in coordination with Medical / Scientific Affairs.

**E. Tender and Institutional Business**

* Lead identification and participation in government and institutional tenders, including pricing strategy, documentation and follow-up.
* Build relationships with hospitals, institutions and procurement agencies in key markets.

**F. Regulatory, Supply and Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work with Regulatory Affairs to plan product registrations, renewals and dossier requirements country-wise, and to prioritise them against business needs.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Production, Quality and Finance for forecasts, order fulfilment, shelf-life management, documentation and collections.
* Ensure compliance with applicable export, regulatory and company policies.

**G. Team Leadership and Governance**

* Hire, develop, coach and set KPIs for Regional Managers / BDMs; conduct regular performance reviews.
* Create a structured review rhythm: monthly secondary sales, stock and forecast reviews, quarterly business reviews and market visits.
* Present international business performance, risks and opportunities to the Managing Director and Management.
* Build a pipeline of internal talent and a succession plan for the international team.

**3. Candidate Profile**

**Essential Experience**

* 15+ years of international business, export or brand-management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing multiple countries and a team.
* Background in Pharmaceuticals, Clinical Nutrition, Medical Nutrition, Nutraceuticals or Healthcare products.

**Preferred Experience**

**Education**

jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed
* **Reporting to:** Project Head
* **Work mode:** On-site at the Chennai office for the project duration

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

jobs.description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Research Engineer, Applied Research (BioTech AI – Drug Discovery)**
**About The Company**
Quantiphi is an award-winning AI-first digital engineering company, driven by a deep desire to solve transformational problems at the heart of businesses. Our signature approach combines groundbreaking machine-learning research with disciplined cloud and data-engineering practices to create breakthrough impact at unprecedented speed.
  
  
Quantiphi has seen 2.5x growth YoY since its inception in 2013 to 3500+ team members globally.
  
  
For more details, please visit our website or LinkedIn page.
  
  
**About Phi Labs**
Phi Labs is an R&D practice at Quantiphi focused on advancing the frontiers of AI technologies with Applied Machine Learning at its core. We ideate and build novel solutions to high-impact, cutting-edge challenges, with a focus on advanced prototyping and scalable proof of concepts.
  
  
Within this unit, the AI-Accelerated Drug Discovery practice is a key pillar that aims to apply state-of-the-art AI methodologies to revolutionize the way new therapeutics are discovered and developed. We are committed to driving meaningful scientific breakthroughs by combining strong AI research with deep cross-disciplinary collaboration.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Level:**
Research Engineer
  
  
**Work Location:**
India
  
  
**The Role**
This is a unique opportunity to work on scientifically impactful problems at the intersection of AI and biotechnology within Phi Labs, Quantiphi’s Applied Research team. In this role, you will work on the development of core AI models and algorithms aimed at accelerating the drug discovery process. This position focuses on key peptide engineering workstreams. This includes In Silico design of Antibodies, mini proteins, cyclic peptides etc.
  
  
The position involves working with a diverse, lively, and proactive group of nerds who are constantly raising the bar on translating the latest AI research in Healthcare and Life Sciences into tangible reusable assets for the community. Hence this would require a high level of conceptual understanding, attention to detail and agility in terms of adaptation to new technologies.
  
  
**While prior experience in the biotech or life sciences domain is highly valued and will elevate the candidate profile, we are equally open to exceptional AI/ML researchers from other domains who are excited to explore and learn the nuances of this rapidly growing field**
.
  
  
***Please note: This is a core AI research role, not a software engineering or system integration position. We are particularly keen to engage with candidates focused on scientific AI innovation rather than application development or LLM/GenAI-centric workflows**
.*
**Responsibilities**

* Stay ahead of the AI research curve, focusing on foundational AI methodologies applicable to protein analysis and protein design.
* Build rapid prototypes, conduct detailed experimental studies, and develop advanced AI models in areas such as generative modeling, reinforcement learning, graph-based learning, and property prediction.
* Work closely with interdisciplinary teams including biologists, chemists, and life science domain experts to design scientifically sound AI approaches.
* Contribute to Quantiphi’s IP portfolio through the development of novel algorithms, proof of concepts, and potential publications.
* Drive thought leadership through documentation, knowledge dissemination, and participation in conferences, blogs, webinars, and publications.
* Publish Research papers in prestigious Conferences and Journals.

**Requirements**
**Must Have:**

* Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Biological Sciences/ Biotechnology, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.
* Minimum work experience required : from new graduates to 3+ yrs of research experience post graduation (in ML research)
* Strong foundation in AI/ML concepts with hands-on experience in model development, experimental design, and large-scale data analysis.
* Excellent in-depth understanding of ML concepts and the respective underlying mathematical know-how.
* Working knowledge of using NLP with biological sequences.
* Solid research mindset with a track record of working on complex AI problems—experience with drug discovery datasets is a plus but not a prerequisite.
* Excellent programming skills in Python, with experience using AI/ML frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Hands-on experience in developing and deploying models with various deep learning architectures in multiple ML areas like Computer-Vision, NLP, Statistics etc
* Ability to independently learn new scientific domains and apply AI techniques to novel bio-pharmaceutical problems.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas in an accessible format across audiences.
* Ability to translate abstract highlights into understandable insights in multiple knowledge-dissemination formats like blogs, presentations, paper-publications, tutorials and webinars

**Good To Have**

* Prior exposure to molecular datasets, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biophysics simulations, or life sciences.
* Hands-on experience with in silico techniques in small molecule or peptide design
* Hands-on experience with the model family of RFDiffusion, ProteinMPNNs and other backbone design techniques
* Familiarity with generative models, graph neural networks, reinforcement learning, or multi-objective optimization.
* Demonstrated industry research experience will be considered as an additional bonus.
* Research publications in AI/ML conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or relevant bioinformatics journals
* Experience with cloud environments like GCP or AWS and scalable model training.
* Strong classical education on math/physics/mechanics/CS/Engineering concepts will also be an advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and biotechnology, solving problems with real-world scientific impact.
* Exposure to interdisciplinary teams and a culture that encourages continuous learning and exploration.
* Contribute to an R&D environment that values curiosity, innovation, and the advancement of AI for good.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

**Base Location: Vadodara**

Key Responsibilities

**Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance**

* Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

**Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance**

* Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

**Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification**

* Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on
  **Frozen RTE and Rice processing**
  .

**Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:**

* Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

**GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification**

* Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

**Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits**

* Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

**Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management**

* Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as
  **5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis**
  . Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

**CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification**

* Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

**Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management**

* Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

**Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

Required Education and Experience

1. A master’s or bachelor’s degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
2. Should have handled 3P operations
3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.

4. Good communication skills.

**Job Description – Strategy and Policy Division, Quality Council of India (Hiring for Policy, Legal, Tech and Marketing roles)**

**About the Team**

Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the QCI is a team of young professionals working towards augmenting the capacity of government bodies in policy making and formulating high-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. Our work at SPD entails numerous domains, which includes creation of a national level product label scheme, a flagship initiative of the Government of India. The team functions as a high-impact delivery unit within QCI, combining policy research, regulatory analysis, and project execution in a fast-paced, government-facing environment.

**Role Summary**

Your role will support the end-to-end operationalisation of various policies & schemes that QCI designs & implements. The support largely involves regulatory research, creating systems, SOP drafting to stakeholder coordination with regulators and industry associations. Depending on the experience, you would be designated as an Analyst, Associate Manager, or Project Manager (see Section 6). This role blends regulatory and standards domain knowledge with policy research, and scheme-level project management.

**Why This Role Is a Unique Opportunity**

This is not a typical corporate or consulting role. You will be at the centre of building India’s branding framework from the ground up – a programme with direct implications for achieving the goals of Atmanirbhar and Viksit Bharat. The work you do here will shape real policy outcomes.

We are looking for individuals who want to point to a national programme and say, “I helped build that.” If you have domain knowledge in manufacturing, standards, or trade policy, combined with intellectual rigour and a commitment to public service, this is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**There are 4 different roles (listed from A to D below) for which we are hiring multiple candidates-**

**A. Strategy & Policy**

* **Research & Synthesis:**
  Research BIS, FSSAI and international standards, testing procedures, QCOs, DGFT import-export regulations, HSN codes, rules of origin, NTBs and SPS rules, and turn findings into concise briefs and policy notes for QCI, DPIIT and other stakeholders.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse sector-level manufacturing and trade data (production, import penetration, localisation, HS-code trade flows) for sector selection, threshold-setting and impact assessment, and present it through dashboards, leadership and ministerial decks, and research, benchmarking and progress reports.
* **Drafting & Documentation:**
  Draft Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, FAQs, proposal notes, inter-ministerial correspondence and approval documents in government format.
* **Stakeholder & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with BIS, BEE, DGFT, Department of Commerce, CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and Sector Council members; prepare agendas, minutes and trackers; and track scheme milestones (portal, sector onboarding, Sector Councils) with ministries and QCI leadership.

**B. Legal**

* **Legal Vetting & Drafting:**
  Draft and vet Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, Sector Addenda, undertakings, certificate holder terms, portal terms and privacy notices, MoUs and vendor contracts; prepare legal notes, opinions and file notings; and flag legal risk before any document is issued.
* **Enforcement, Disputes & Litigation:**
  Draft show-cause notices, suspension and cancellation orders, and grievance and appeal decisions in line with natural justice and SOP timelines. Manage challenges from notice to outcome: keep the court and limitation calendar, brief counsel, review pleadings, attend hearings, advise on appeals, and coordinate with the nodal Department where the Union of India is a party.
* **Law Firm & Panel Management:**
  Empanel law firms and counsel; allocate matters, fix scope and fees in work orders and check invoices; and hold firms to QCI’s standards on availability, forum coverage (Supreme Court to district courts, tribunals and consumer fora), conflicts and reporting.
* **IP & Brand Protection:**
  Protect the scheme’s name, logo and QR mark in India and abroad: trademark and certification mark filings, licence terms, register watch, oppositions, online takedowns, cease and desist notices and infringement actions.
* **Regulatory & Trade Law Research:**
  Interpret the BIS Act and QCOs, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, Foreign Trade Policy, customs and rules of origin, WTO and FTA obligations, trademark and GI law, the Consumer Protection Act and CCPA guidelines, and the DPDP and RTI Acts, and brief leadership at QCI and DPIIT.
* **Coordination, Records & Reporting:**
  Coordinate with DPIIT, BIS, DGFT, CCPA, law officers and industry bodies; maintain the Matter Register and precedent bank and feed lessons into SOPs; safeguard manufacturer data (including BOM and cost data); handle RTI and grievance responses; and report on open matters, risk and legal spend.

**C. Technology (Scheme Portal)**

* **Requirements, Design & Product Ownership:**
  Translate the Scheme Guidelines and SOPs into requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria for each portal module; own the backlog and release roadmap; and review the vendor’s UI/UX, architecture, data models and integrations so the portal is simple for MSMEs, bilingual, mobile-responsive and accessible.
* **Vendor & Delivery Management:**
  Support the RFP and bid evaluation; govern the vendor against plan, milestones and SLAs; assess change requests for scope, effort and cost; and verify deliverables before milestone payments.
* **Testing, Security & Go-Live:**
  Run UAT, triage defects and sign off releases; oversee go-live, data migration and rollback; and ensure CERT-In empanelled audits, compliance with GIGW, the DPDP Act, 2023 and hosting norms, and sound backups, disaster recovery, access control and audit trails.
* **Operations, Support & Reporting:**
  Monitor uptime, helpdesk and incidents against SLAs; secure documentation and knowledge transfer to avoid vendor lock-in; coordinate manuals and training; and define MIS dashboards for QCI and DPIIT.

**D. Marketing & IEC**

* **Marketing Strategy, Research & Campaign Planning:**
  Support the development of marketing and IEC strategies, campaign plans, audience segmentation, communication objectives and key messages, informed by market, audience and communication research and stakeholder feedback.
* **Brand Communication & Content Development:**
  Develop and coordinate clear, consistent communication materials such as brochures, presentations, FAQs, reports, infographics, videos, digital creatives and campaign content.
* **Digital Marketing, Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Coordinate digital outreach, social media content calendars, channel dissemination and audience engagement; track outreach coverage, participation, digital reach and engagement; and use these insights to refine communication and prepare periodic reports and recommendations.
* **Outreach, Events & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Support awareness campaigns, workshops, conferences, trade fairs and outreach activities; coordinate with internal teams, industry bodies, partners and other stakeholders.
* **Agency & Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate briefs, deliverables, timelines and quality reviews with marketing, creative, media, event and IEC agencies or vendors.

**Required Capabilities**

We expect an ideal candidate to demonstrate the following capabilities:

**Research & AI Efficiency:**
Rapidly interpret standards, QCOs, BEE schedules, DGFT notifications and tariff schedules, using AI tools for faster research and drafting.

**High-Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in India’s manufacturing, trade and standards ecosystem and its policy developments.

jobs.title: Urgent Opening For Senior Visa Executive(Chennai/Pune)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are launching a new visa and travel documentation service for travellers based in Kuwait, delivered in partnership with an established Kuwait travel agency. You will be the first hire on this desk: you will prepare and manage visa applications end to end, from checking what each traveller needs to booking their appointment and tracking the result.

Applicants hold many different passports, including Kuwaiti, Indian, other South Asian, Arab and other expatriate nationalities, and apply through embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait. The core skill is working out exactly what each case requires, not following a single checklist.

The desk covers **every destination and visa category that travellers can apply for from Kuwait**: visit and tourist, business, student, work, family and dependant, and transit visas, for destinations such as the UK, the US, the Schengen Area, Canada, Australia, the other Gulf states and Asia. Because this is a new desk, you will help shape how it works, and the role will grow with the volume.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Receive new cases from our partner agency and confirm each traveller's nationality, destination, travel dates and purpose.
* Determine visa requirements for each case (whether a visa is needed, which category and which documents) and send the traveller a tailored checklist.
* Review documents such as passports, bank statements, employment and salary letters, bookings and invitations; flag gaps or risks before submission.
* Complete online and paper applications accurately for any destination, such as UK visa forms, the US DS-160 and Schengen, Canadian and Australian applications.
* Book and manage appointments at embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait, and brief travellers on their in-person biometrics visit.
* Draft supporting documents: cover letters, day-by-day travel itineraries and invitation-letter templates.
* Track every application in a shared case log and keep the partner agency and management informed of status, delays and outcomes.
* Keep up to date with changes in visa rules, fees and appointment procedures, and maintain internal checklists for each destination and nationality.
* Refer any case that needs licensed immigration advice in the destination country to a qualified, regulated adviser.
* Handle all client documents and personal data in strict confidence, following iMarque's data-security procedures.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 3 years of hands-on visa processing at a visa consultancy, travel agency or travel management company (TMC); more experience is welcome.
* Proven experience preparing visa applications for multiple destinations, including at least the UK, the US and the Schengen Area.
* Experience across several visa categories (visit, business, student, work and family), and an understanding of how requirements differ by nationality and country of residence.
* Quick to learn a new country's process from official sources.
* Excellent written English; able to draft clear, professional cover letters.
* Strong attention to detail: an error on a form can mean a refusal.
* Organised and comfortable managing many cases at once in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable working a shift aligned to Kuwait business hours.
* Willing to undergo a background verification.

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with applications filed from Kuwait or another Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) country.
* Experience with online portals of visa application centres.
* Experience with Canada, Australia, GCC or East Asian visa processes.
* Hindi, Arabic, Malayalam or Urdu.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* The chance to build a new service line from the ground up.
* A growth path to lead the visa desk as the team expands.

  

**HOW TO APPLY**

We are hiring immediately; immediate joiners, or candidates with a notice period of 30 days or less, are preferred.

Send your CV to **[Application email]** with the subject line **Senior Visa Executive – [Your Name]”**. In a few lines, tell us which countries' visas you have handled and roughly how many applications you processed per month in your last role.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

It is the responsibility of the post holder to provide all clients, both internal and external, with the appropriate quality of service in a safe and cost-effective manner.
