Home to some of the UAE’s best-loved brands, including Lacnor, Laban Up, Oasis, Milco and Safa, NFPC is looking for a
**Quality Technologist**
to join our Quality team.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The Quality Technologist ensures that Fresh and UHT products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. They analyze product samples and run routine tests, including pH, conductivity, and the concentration of chemicals used, and they assess packaging materials. They also apply hygiene best practices across operations, carry out internal audits, and keep accurate quality records. Working within the quality team, they implement and maintain quality standards, procedures, and systems that meet UAE regulatory requirements and support consistent product quality.

**ESSENTIAL ACCOUNTABILITIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND KPIs**

**Testing & Analysis**

* Perform physical, chemical, and microbiological tests on raw milk, ingredients, and finished dairy products, including fat, protein, titratable acidity, pH, moisture, and microbiological counts.
* Carry out environmental and allergen swabbing to verify sanitation effectiveness.
* Test packaging integrity and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for corrective action.

**Process Control**

* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters across pasteurisation, fermentation, filling, and packaging. Make sure CCPs stay within defined limits and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for immediate corrective action.

**Raw & Packaging Materials**

* Inspect incoming raw and packaging materials in line with the company’s raw material receiving programme. Prepare summary reports on supplier ratings and material disposition.
* Take part in qualifying new ingredients, raw materials, and packaging materials, including machine runnability, stability testing, and pre-commercial and commercial trials.
* Lead the closure of packaging-related Non-Conformance Action Reports (NCARs), including reviewing and validating suppliers’ corrective and preventive actions.

**Compliance & Audits**

* Ensure compliance with HACCP, ISO, FSSC 22000, and other food safety and quality management systems.
* Implement Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA) procedures across manufacturing and supply chain functions to reduce food safety risks.
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and maintain accurate quality documentation.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of quality assurance or quality control experience, preferably in dairy or juice manufacturing.
* HACCP Level 3 certification.

A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The Manager, Packaging Development leads the Packaging Development & Industrialization team of Product Operations. This role owns the technical delivery of every packaging launch, from brief to PPS and production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, so each launch is safe, on time and proven. It applies risk-based pathways, runs pilot-first development for new high-risk packs, and decides on evidence, not on supplier statements.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Launch Portfolio Delivery**

* Own the technical delivery of the packaging launch portfolio, from brief to PPS.
* Review briefs early and give feasibility, cost, timing and risk input, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, risk and capacity.
* Personally lead a selected set of the most complex, high-risk launches.
* Escalate early any risk to launch date, quality or cost, with facts and options.

**Risk-Based Development & Evidence**

* Classify each project at the brief by what is new and its 1 to 5 risk score; propose the pathway (Fast Lane, Targeted, Full Pilot-First) for confirmation by Quality.
* For new, high-risk packs, run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests and line trials on pilot parts before any production mold.
* Prepare the evidence for the Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation and GO PROD gates.
* Apply Specifications checkpoints in proportion to risk, with an owner, evidence and sign-off for each.
* Define the test strategy and acceptance criteria with Quality.

**Packaging Engineering**

* Own drawings, critical dimensions, GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.
* Lead functional analysis, DFMA, decoration feasibility and formula/pack/process compatibility.
* Use proven platforms and supplier standards from Packaging R&D wherever they fit.
* Keep approved specifications up to date in Specright.

**Industrialization & CM Readiness**

* Lead tooling strategy and mold validation (T0 to T3) with suppliers.
* Confirm supplier and CM technical capability at the Tech Assessment.
* Organize and attend line trials; secure PPS on the final formula.
* Manage technical changes, deviations and concessions through change control, with Quality.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging engineers and developers.
* Set clear ownership, standards and a regular project review cadence.
* Keep the project portfolio data accurate, as the basis for capacity decisions.
* Feed lessons learned into specifications, design rules and Kaizen priorities.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain and Regulatory.
* Give technical input on supplier choices; Procurement leads RFQs and negotiation.
* Represent Packaging Development in launch reviews and at the Newness Committee when required.
* Contribute to value engineering and COGS savings without trading critical risk.

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of primary packs (e.g., mascara, gloss, compacts, closures, pumps) from brief to production at external suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Strong command of technical drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and injection molding.
* Hands-on experience of mold validation, line trials, PPS and packaging test methods.
* Solid knowledge of formula/pack compatibility and filling and assembly processes.
* Experience leading or coaching packaging engineers.
* Able to review CAD models (SolidWorks or similar) and run a portfolio in a project tool (Asana or similar).
* Able to travel to suppliers and contract manufacturers in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of structured, evidence-based delivery, staying calm under pressure and comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 8+ years in packaging development, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

The Senior Director of Packaging leads the Packaging pole of Product Operations: Packaging Development & Industrialization, and a new Packaging R&D capability. This role owns the technical packaging solution from brief to production readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers, moves technical risk upstream through risk-based pilots and evidence, and builds proven, PPWR-ready platforms for future launches. It works with an independent End-to-End Quality team.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**Packaging Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own the packaging technical strategy and roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Lead two sub-poles, Development & Industrialization and Packaging R&D, through strong leads with clear decision rights.
* Protect R&D time and budget from live-launch pressure; escalate trade-offs to the VP, Product Operations.
* Size the team from real workload and portfolio data.

**Packaging Development & Industrialization**

* Own the technical delivery of every launch, from brief to PPS.
* Run risk-based pathways, set from the 1 to 5 risk score and confirmed by Quality.
* Secure pilot molds and homologation before production tooling for new, high-risk packs.
* Lead drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, functional analysis, DFMA and formula/pack compatibility.
* Own tooling validation, line trials, PPS and scale-up readiness at suppliers and contract manufacturers.

**Packaging R&D & Innovation**

* Build and lead Packaging R&D: platforms and technology, advanced development and innovation, Kaizen.
* Build a library of proven packs, supplier standards, design rules and test files.
* Lead technical and experience sourcing.
* Hand concepts over to development only once proven.

**Sustainability & PPWR**

* Own the packaging sustainability roadmap, balancing consumer experience, brand, cost and regulation.
* Lead PPWR readiness for new launches and the existing portfolio, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Set clear ownership: R&D builds PPWR-ready solutions, Development applies them in each launch, Regulatory and Legal advise on compliance.
* Prioritize changes to existing packs by risk and business impact, with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Technical Governance & Risk Ownership**

* Adapt assessments to project risk, with clear ownership, evidence and approval at each checkpoint.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for the Product Operations gates: Tech Assessment, Pilot Homologation, Go Prod.
* Own packaging specifications and drive the adoption of the internal specification tool.
* Never trade an unresolved critical risk for cost or timing; any skipped step goes to the Newness Committee.
* Lead root cause and permanent fixes for design-origin issues; support Quality and the Crisis Cell on supply issues.
* Respect Quality's independent co-signature of homologation and its ownership of release and CAPA.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Lead, coach and develop packaging developers, engineers and R&D specialists.
* Recruit and grow sub-pole leads; build succession for critical technical roles.
* Act as a role model for technical rigor and evidence-based decisions.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Commercial and Finance.
* Bring feasibility, cost, timing and risk input at the brief, with the pack brief issued alongside the formula brief.
* Represent Packaging at the Newness Committee and in launch readiness reviews.
* Drive value engineering and COGS improvement without trading critical risk; manage the packaging technical budget

**Requirements**

* Proven delivery of complex primary packs from concept through tooling, line trials and scale-up at suppliers and contract manufacturers.
* Deep expertise in materials, processes, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups and formula/pack compatibility.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, homologation and stage-gate governance.
* Experience building a pre-development, R&D or platform program.
* Proven leader of leaders, delegating through clear decision rights.
* Able to read and challenge CAD models and technical drawings.
* Solid understanding of packaging sustainability and the EU PPWR, and their impact on design, cost and supply.
* Experience with global supplier bases in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of evidence-based judgment, comfortable with ambiguity and scale-up dynamics.
* 15+ years in packaging development and industrialization, with significant beauty, fragrance or luxury experience.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatician
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Overview**
M42 is a global health champion powered by artificial intelligence (AI), technology and genomics to advance innovation in health for people and the planet. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, M42 combines its specialized, state-of-the-art facilities with integrated health solutions like genomics and biobanks, and harnesses advanced technologies to deliver precise, preventive and predictive care, to disrupt traditional healthcare models and positively impact lives globally.
  
  
The Senior Bioinformatician will join a large genomics and bioinformatics team supporting the Emirati Genome Program (EGP), a national-scale whole genome sequencing initiative. The role is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and automation of large-scale genomic data processing workflows, ensuring reliable, scalable, and reproducible analysis across diverse sequencing technologies. The position contributes to the advancement of production genomics capabilities through workflow innovation, cloud-based computing solutions, quality control frameworks, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable bioinformatics pipelines and workflows for large-scale genomic data processing.
* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.
* Develop and manage workflow orchestration platforms such as Nextflow and equivalent workflow management systems.
* Improve workflow scalability, reproducibility, monitoring, performance, and reliability across high-volume sequencing datasets.
* Evaluate, benchmark, and integrate new bioinformatics tools, sequencing technologies, and analytical approaches into production environments.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and unexpected analytical results.
* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.
* Contribute to cloud-based genomic computing environments, containerization technologies, workload optimization, and reproducible software deployment practices.
* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Significant experience in production bioinformatics, genomic computing, workflow development, cloud genomics, or related technical fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale genomics infrastructure, pipeline development, or workflow automation projects.
* Experience working with whole genome sequencing (WGS) datasets and large-scale genomic analysis environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, workflow orchestration frameworks, and high-performance computing environments is strongly preferred.
* Scientific publications, open-source contributions, or ownership of large-scale genomics systems are advantageous.
* Strong programming skills in Python, shell scripting, or related languages.
* Advanced Linux command-line proficiency.
* Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of genomic processing tools such as DRAGEN, Sentieon, GATK, bcftools, samtools, and related technologies.
* Experience with Docker, Singularity/Apptainer, containerized workflows, and reproducible software environments.
* Strong understanding of genomic file formats including FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF, and gVCF.
* Expertise in genomic quality control, variant calling, structural variation analysis, and large-scale genomic data processing.
* Familiarity with Git, software version control, and workflow testing practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary technical and scientific teams.

Develop computational approaches to identify and evaluate potential drug candidates.

Research predictive methods for drug properties, efficacy and safety.

Explore AI models for predicting molecular and biological responses.

Collaborate across AI, pharmaceutical sciences and computational biology.

jobs.title: F&B Licensing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About Wynn Al Marjan Island:**
Wynn Al Marjan Island will be the first integrated resort in the UAE. Set to open in 2027, the resort will be located 50 miles from Dubai International Airport in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. It will feature multiple swimming and wading pools, water features, a five-star spa, a salon, a shopping promenade, and a celebrations and events center.
  
  
**About The Position**
Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking F&B Licensing Manager to join the resort’s Food & Beverage team.
  
  
**The Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role Are**

* Build and maintain the end ‑ to ‑ end licensing roadmap for Food & Beverage operations (restaurants, bars/lounges, in ‑ venue service points, storage areas, kitchens, outdoor spaces), mapping initial approvals, renewals, amendments, and closures.
* Own a central license register (master tracker) covering legal entity documents, trade/operational licenses, alcohol/beverage permissions where applicable, health & hygiene certificates, music/entertainment permits, signage, outdoor seating, terrace use, delivery, and vehicle/transport approvals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant Emirate ‑ level and federal authorities (e.g., Economic Development, Municipality/Public Health, Tourism Authority, Civil Defense, Police/Events, and other regulators as applicable) to obtain, amend, and renew approvals.
* Interpret new regulations, assess impact, and update SOPs; cascade requirements across venues and support implementation.
* Lead all event ‑ related licensing and notifications (e.g., celebrations, tastings, brand activations, outdoor events, one ‑ off extensions of hours/areas), coordinating site plans, crowd management, entertainment permits, and security/Civil Defense clearances.
* Partner with Restaurant Events and venue leaders to build permit ‑ ready event packs (layouts, capacities, NOCs, risk assessments) and to secure approvals on time
* Oversee authorized PROs, translation/legalization services, and specialized consultants; negotiate scopes, SLAs, and fees.
* Maintain a calendar of statutory payments (govt. fees, renewals, inspections) and forecast the licensing budget; reconcile costs against plan.
* Maintain accurate license files (digital and physical), logs of submissions and approvals, and a library of approved layouts/certificates.
* Publish weekly dashboards (licenses due in 90/60/30 days, event permits in progress, inspection outcomes, fines/penalties avoided).
* Run the daily licensing control room: check expiries, validate opening checklists for permit ‑ dependent activities, and green ‑ light venue operations.
* Review event requests; confirm permitting path, lead times, and documentation; submit and track approvals through to issuance.
* Verify display of licenses (where mandated), on ‑ site documentation (HACCP, allergen matrices, employee certifications), and emergency contacts.
* Work with the respective outlet management team and designate Venue Licensing Champions in each outlet.
* Conduct induction and refresher training on licensing rules (alcohol service where applicable, events, outdoor use, deliveries, signage), documentation, and inspection etiquette.
* Monitor UAE market and regulatory trends; recommend operational adjustments and process improvements.
* Collaborate positively with all departments and contractors; lead cross ‑ functional licensing meetings and share relevant updates.

**About You:**
The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* 4–6 years in licensing/compliance for hospitality/Food & Beverage, large venues, or integrated resorts in the UAE; proven track record managing multi ‑ venue portfolios and events permits.
* Working knowledge of UAE/Emirate ‑ level licensing frameworks, municipal public health, tourism/entertainment permits, Civil Defense requirements, and HACCP/food safety.
* Advantageous: experience with alcohol licensing and responsible service standards where applicable; Arabic reading or business proficiency.
* Familiarity with e ‑ government portals and document legalization/attestation processes.
* Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, document management systems, and tracker dashboards (e.g., Excel/SharePoint/Power BI).

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

As our company-employed, UAE-based Deputy QPPV, you will provide qualified backup coverage to the UAE QPPV and help ensure continued pharmacovigilance oversight, business continuity and inspection readiness. * Collaborate closely with Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Medical, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal and global and regional Regulatory Affairs teams to manage risks and ensure compliant execution.

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy.
* Valid UAE Pharmacist license.

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory & Compliance Manager to join the Amazon Now team to ensure technical and regulatory compliance across our engineering operations. This role will be crucial in achieving and maintaining compliance standards while scaling our engineering infrastructure across UAE.
  
  
In this role, the candidate will lead end-to-end compliance management for Amazon Now operations, overseeing due diligence processes, permit acquisitions, and renewal procedures. The ideal candidate will navigate complex regulatory landscapes and manage compliance uncertainties across all project phases. This role requires strong stakeholder management skills to collaborate with external partners in developing and implementing comprehensive compliance frameworks that ensure Amazon Now facilities meet all building codes and operational regulations. Key responsibilities include establishing compliance protocols, maintaining regulatory documentation, coordinating with authorities, and providing strategic guidance to ensure continuous operational compliance.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Manage engineering compliance throughout all project stages from initiation to operation.
  
  
Develop and implement engineering compliance frameworks that align with regional regulatory requirements.
  
  
Review technical drawings and engineering solutions to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  
  
Manage continuous improvement in engineering compliance processes and controls.

Establish and maintain relationships with regulatory authorities regarding technical compliance matters.

jobs.title: Establishment Services Sr. Specialists | Emirati Talent
jobs.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

Establishment Services Senior Specialist is responsible for managing day-to-day establishment and regulatory activities, ensuring timely processing of trade license renewals, permits, inspections, and compliance requirements. The role supervises operational execution, maintains regulatory compliance, and serves as the primary escalation point for issues with UAE government authorities.

**ROLE PROFILE**

* Supervise the execution of trade license, permit, and regulatory transactions, ensuring timely processing of renewals, amendments, and cancellations.
* Monitor workflows and documentation to ensure accurate and compliant submissions to government authorities across all emirates.
* Coordinate municipality and civil defence inspections, ensuring readiness and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Manage relationships with government entities and serve as the first point of escalation for regulatory issues and approval delays.
* Lead, coach, and support associates, assigning daily tasks and ensuring adherence to established SOPs and service standards.
* Oversee the maintenance of trackers for licenses, permits, inspections, and compliance obligations to mitigate operational risks.
* Train and onboard team members on government portals, systems, and regulatory requirements to ensure operational excellence.
* Prepare and deliver regular performance, compliance, and operational reports to management, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration or a related discipline.
* 5–7 years of experience in UAE government relations, establishment services, or regulatory operations.
* Strong knowledge of trade licensing, municipality permits, civil defence requirements, and regulatory compliance processes.
* Proven experience leading or supervising teams responsible for government transactions and approvals.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and operational reporting tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

jobs.title: Sr. FnB Manager - Outlets
jobs.description:
The purpose of this business unit is to deliver exceptional food and beverage experiences across the lounges and mezzanine restaurants at Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Dubai World Central (DWC). The department aims to enhance the F&B experience for our airline clients and their passengers through strategic management of skilled staff, revenue control, and cost efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

1. Oversee compliance with the company safety management system, HACCP, and hygiene policies, aligning with EKFC safety standards and government regulations to provide a safe environment for all guests.
2. Lead coordination with the central purchasing department to secure fixed assets and coordinate with stores to efficiently manage inventory, ensuring operational continuity and resource optimization.
3. Strategize manpower planning by defining requirements per position, developing a robust recruitment pipeline, implementing on-job orientation programs, overseeing training frameworks, and monitoring staff performance to ensure operational efficiency and professional development.
4. Drive revenue growth through cost control measures, while supporting budget preparation to achieve financial objectives and operational excellence.
5. Collaborate with the Production Department to guide menu implementation, food presentation, and kitchen-related strategies to consistently deliver exceptional food quality and presentation to customers.
6. Champion the application of the Quality Policy and Quality System in accordance with ISO 9001:2015 standards to ensure compliance.
7. Develop new F&B concepts inspired by the latest market trends and oversee their implementation to enhance the organization’s competitive edge and guest experience.
8. Partner with F&B Managers and HR to develop and execute strategies aimed at reducing staff attrition and fostering an engaged, high-performing workforce.
9. Evaluate client feedback and passenger surveys to identify key improvement opportunities, and drive the implementation of recommendations to elevate service standards and client satisfaction.

**Education Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, hotel management or any relevant field (must have).
* Master’s degree in hospitality, hotel management or any relevant field (preferred).

**Work Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years’ experience in the hospitality industry, with 2 years’ experience in the executive level with proven ability in managing multiple concepts and outlets (F&B senior leadership/ directorial/ executive role).
* Pre-opening experience in high volume and premium F&B operations
* Demonstrated achievements in high revenue and cost control
* Experience and understanding of luxury and large volume hotels and multi-site restaurant operations
* Experience working with local, regional and national suppliers
* International experience in renown brands with preferably in GCC market.

**Skills:**

* Self-motivated and demonstrate sound leadership skills
* A keen eye for opportunity identification and a high level of motivation
* Able to create personalized F&B experience
* Able to prepare & submit the annual CAPEX and staff budget
* Planning and Organizational skills are a key to be successful in this role
* Capable of sharing recommendations and clients comments with the Executive Chefs and F&B Management team.
* Excellent communication skills
* Experienced in food safety, OHS, quality assurance and risk management.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.description:
**Location: Northeast**

**Territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas for this position.*

*TG Therapeutics is an equal employment opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, ancestry, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition or any other protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: Path 1 Kawader: Research Assistant – Fisheries and Coastal Communities Research
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
NYU Abu Dhabi invites applications for a Kawader Research Assistant Fellow position in Fisheries and Coastal Communities Research within the Burt Marine Biology Lab and the Mubadala Arabian Center for Climate and Environmental Sciences (ACCESS).
  
  
The Burt Marine Biology Lab and Mubadala Arabian Center for Climate and Environmental Sciences (ACCESS) at New York University Abu Dhabi are seeking a motivated Emirati Kawader Research Assistant to support a multidisciplinary research project focused on fisheries productivity and sustainable fisheries management in the UAE.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with researchers from NYU Abu Dhabi and Emirates Nature–WWF to investigate the environmental, social, and economic factors influencing fishing ground productivity and fisheries sustainability.
  
  
What the Program Offers
  
  

* Full-time paid research position for up to 3 years.
* Mentorship by internationally recognized NYUAD faculty members and researchers.
* Professional development and academic training opportunities.
* Exposure to interdisciplinary and collaborative research projects.
* Support in preparing for graduate school applications.
* Research experience in fisheries sustainability, environmental conservation, and coastal community studies.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assist with stakeholder engagement activities involving fishers, government agencies, industry representatives, and conservation organizations.
* Support the design and implementation of interviews, surveys, and other social science research activities.
* Participate in field visits, meetings, and workshops across the UAE, particularly in Abu Dhabi and Umm Al Quwain.
* Assist with data collection, organization, management, and basic quantitative and qualitative analysis.
* Contribute to literature reviews, report preparation, presentations, and research summaries.
* Support communication and coordination between project partners and stakeholders.

**Supervision**
This position is supervised by the Burt Marine Biology Lab and ACCESS research team at NYU Abu Dhabi.
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in social sciences, public policy, environmental studies, sustainability, economics, geography, or a related field.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken).
* Interest in environmental conservation, fisheries, coastal communities, or sustainability issues.
* Experience with interviews, surveys, stakeholder engagement, or social science research methods.
* Familiarity with quantitative data analysis or statistical software.
* Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel within the UAE for meetings, workshops, and field activities.

For questions regarding the position, please contact
**nyuad.kawader@nyu.edu.**
Learning Outcomes
  
  
The Kawader Research Assistant will gain hands-on experience in applied environmental research, stakeholder engagement, mixed-methods social science research, and conservation policy while working alongside leading researchers and national conservation partners.
  
  

* CV
* Statement of interest
* Transcript(s)
* Two reference letters

For questions regarding the position, please contact nyuad.kawader@nyu.edu.

UAE nationals are encouraged to apply
  
  
This position is under the NYUAD Kawader program, for details regarding the program, open dates, specific program requirements, and FAQ's please refer to our NYUAD Kawader webpage: https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/about/careers/postdoctoral-and-research/kawader-research-assistantship-program.html

jobs.title: Senior Sales Representative
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Profile Snapshot**

**Title:**
Senior Sales Representative

**Location:**
Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

**Position Type:**
Full Time

**Overview:**

The Technical Sales Representative – Farm Solutions will support the growth of Agrivita’s Farm Solutions portfolio, starting with Biosecurity Solutions, by creating demand at Small Poultry farms (SPF), Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries and Slaughterhouses’ channels, conducting structured customer visits, demonstrating correct product application, and converting technical needs into sustainable sales. The role requires a young, high-potential profile with strong learning agility, poultry technical grounding, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to build trust with farm owners, veterinarians, production managers, and farm teams. Exposure to large animals is an added advantage.

**How Will You Make An Impact?**

**Sales Operations**

* **Demand Generation:**
  Promote Agrivita Farm Solutions, with immediate focus on Biosecurity Solutions, across poultry farms, SPF, Vet Pharmacies, Hatcheries, Slaughterhouses and relevant retail/outlet customers.
* **Poultry Technical Support:**
  Provide first-line technical guidance on cleaning and disinfection programs, biosecurity routines, product selection, dilution, application method, and safe handling in line with approved labels and company guidance.
* **Customer Development:**
  Identify and qualify new farm opportunities, build strong relationships with owners, veterinarians, farm managers and production teams, and follow up consistently to convert interest into orders.
* **Farm Visits & Demonstrations:**
  Conduct regular face-to-face visits, product demonstrations, farm walk-throughs and post-visit follow-ups to reinforce correct usage and value creation.
* **Technical Learning & Product Mastery:**
  Rapidly build and maintain strong knowledge of the Farm Solutions portfolio, poultry production basics, disease pressure drivers, and competitive offerings.
* **Sales Execution:**
  Support achievement of sales, volume and margin targets through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, order follow-up and coordination with customer service and supply chain.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Capture customer feedback, competitor activity, pricing insights, product performance observations and unmet needs, and share them through structured reports.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with sales, marketing, technical, QA/lab, customer service and supply chain teams to ensure customer issues are resolved quickly and professionally.
* **Large Animal Support:**
  Support large animal Farm Solutions opportunities when required; prior exposure to ruminants/large animals is a plus.

**Special Projects**

* Support new Farm Solutions launches, customer trials, campaign rollouts, training events, and any special projects requested by Agthia leadership.

**MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare accurate and timely visit reports, sales pipeline updates, customer feedback, competitor intelligence, product performance observations and monthly progress summaries in line with Agthia and department requirements.

**Qualifications, Experience & Functional knowledge**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Poultry Science, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
* Poultry-focused technical education or training is preferred.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in poultry technical sales, animal health, farm biosecurity, farm management, or technical customer support.
* Early-career, high-potential profile with strong learning agility and willingness to spend significant time in the field.
* Experience with cleaning, disinfection, hygiene, biosecurity products or poultry farm operations is preferred.
* Exposure to large animals / ruminants is an added advantage.

**Functional knowledge**

* Good understanding of poultry production, farm biosecurity principles, disease prevention basics, and cleaning/disinfection workflows.
* Ability to learn product chemistry, dilution rates, application methods and safety requirements quickly and accurately.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to engage confidently with farm owners, veterinarians, managers and workers.
* Commercial mindset with ability to convert technical discussions into sales opportunities.
* Valid UAE driving license or willingness to obtain one is preferred.

**Grow with Agthia – For the Better**

Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food & Beverage companies, with a growing international footprint. We are a publicly listed company on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and part of ADQ, one of region’s largest holding companies.

Rooted in Abu Dhabi since 1978, we've grown into a global presence, operating in countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Turkey, and Jordan. We’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market-leading brands across Water & Food, Snacking, Protein & Frozen, and Agri-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world-first products, setting new benchmarks in industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.

Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”

Join us and be part of a team that's not just shaping the future of food and beverage but also making a meaningful impact on the world. Together, let's grow 'For the Better.'

jobs.title: Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**
Location: Dubai (UAE) | Remote
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you ready to build your commercial career in a specialised market where animal biosecurity, food safety and hygiene make a real difference?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Junior Sales Representative – Animal Biosecurity & Food & Beverage (Middle East)**
to support the growth of LANXESS’ Material Protection Products business across the Middle East. You will focus on developing new business, strengthening customer and distributor relationships, and expanding our presence across animal biosecurity and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
The portfolio includes
**speciality biocides, disinfectants, hygiene solutions and preservation technologies**
used across animal production, poultry, dairy, livestock, food processing, beverage manufacturing and related industrial hygiene markets.
  
  
This is a commercially focused role for someone who enjoys being close to customers, spotting opportunities and developing business across different markets and cultures. You will work with customers, distributors, and internal technical, regulatory, and marketing colleagues while building your knowledge of the region and our applications.
  
  
The position is based in Dubai and covers the wider Middle East region.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop new business across the Middle East, identifying opportunities in animal biosecurity, poultry, livestock, dairy, food processing, beverage production and related markets.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, regional producers, multinational companies, distributors, consultants and other industry partners.
* Support and develop the regional distributor network, identifying opportunities to improve market coverage and penetration.
* Help develop country and customer growth plans and maintain a healthy pipeline of commercial opportunities.
* Act as a commercial contact for customers and distributors, helping them identify solutions for their application needs.
* Support existing customers through technical selling, product qualification, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Work closely with technical experts to support customer evaluations and deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with regulatory, marketing and technical colleagues on product registrations, approvals and market-access activities.
* Monitor customer needs, market trends, competitors and regulatory developments, and turn those insights into commercial opportunities.
* Maintain sales forecasts, opportunities, customer visit reports and relevant market intelligence through CRM and IBP processes.
* Represent LANXESS at relevant exhibitions, conferences, trade associations and technical seminars.
* Support new product introductions and take commercial projects from initial opportunity through to commercialisation.
* Travel regularly across the Middle East to meet customers, distributors and other business partners.

**Work Experience**
We are looking for someone early in their commercial career who combines business drive with an interest in technical products and customer applications.
  
  
**Ideally, You Have**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Veterinary Science, Animal Science, Chemical Engineering or another relevant discipline.
* Relevant B2B sales or business development experience. Because this is a junior position, we can consider profiles with approximately 1–2 years of experience, provided they have strong sector exposure or directly transferable experience.
* Commercial exposure to at least one relevant area, such as animal biosecurity, animal health, poultry, livestock, dairy, veterinary hygiene, food processing, beverage production, food safety, sanitation, hygiene/disinfection or related technical solutions.
* Experience working with relevant B2B customers, such as poultry integrators, dairy producers, livestock operations, food processors, distributors, veterinary professionals, or hygiene/quality teams, is highly relevant.
* Experience managing distributors, regional accounts, prospecting, or new-business development is an advantage.
* An understanding of disinfectants, hygiene solutions, speciality chemicals or related application technologies.
* Strong communication, relationship-building and commercial skills, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across an international organisation.
* Fluent English and Arabic for professional customer interaction.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the Middle East.

**Important Eligibility Requirement**
Candidates must already be living in Dubai and have the legal right to live and work in the UAE without requiring a new visa or work-permit sponsorship for this application.
  
  
**Benefits**
This opportunity lets you develop your sales career in a regional, customer-facing role covering the Middle East, working with an international speciality-chemicals business and a technically differentiated portfolio spanning animal biosecurity, hygiene, and Food & Beverage applications.
  
  
**You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Gain exposure to a broad range of customers, distributors and industry stakeholders across the Middle East.
* Build experience across business development, technical selling, distributor management and regional account development.
* Work collaboratively with technical, regulatory and marketing specialists in an international organisation.
* Build market knowledge across animal biosecurity, food safety, sanitation, hygiene and related speciality applications.
* Develop a regional commercial network through customer visits, distributor collaboration and participation in industry events.

**A third-party employment provider will issue the employment contract, and you will work as an external employee supporting LANXESS.**

jobs.title: Quality Specialist - Amazon Now
jobs.description:
**Description**
Interested in working on an innovative and high-impact business that is changing the way customers think about grocery? The Amazon Now (AE) is offering a role to own building new business from ground Zero.
  
  
Quality of Meat, Seafood, Produce and Perishable is a critical objective for Amazon Now (AE) business and one of the key differentiators for Amazon Now customers. Category Quality team is the one responsible for ensuring that we consistently meet and exceed on that high bar. As part of this team, your primary responsibility will be to assist vendors in optimizing their operations to meet and exceed the Amazon quality bar for Meat, Seafood, Produce and Perishable on a daily basis. Beyond day-to-day inspection, you will be expected to drive process improvement initiatives and actively participate in stakeholder meetings.
  
  
You will play a critical role in improving customer satisfaction metrics, bringing buying efficiency for Fresh produce, and reducing damage / expiry due to bad produce quality. This will require collaboration with various internal teams, including instock managers, vendor managers, store operation managers and fulfillment partners. The ideal candidate will have strong interpersonal and execution skills to handle daily operations and continuously drive process improvements and automation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Review the quality of Meat, Seafood, Fruits, Vegetables, Eggs, and other perishable items during the inbound at Amazon stores, hubs and vendors sites
* Reject the damaged/defective items back to the vendor
* Make a note of the items rejected during the inbound (by item/by vendor, quantity)
* Audit the quality during picking & packing process performed by the LPC associates
* Monitor the Packaging standards during packing process
* Perform daily audit of Bins and share weekly/daily report with the stakeholders
* Train the store and hub associates on quality, SOPs and packaging.
* The role might require work over weekend but not exceeding 40 hours work week

**Desired Traits**

* Eye for details and operational excellence.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with a focus on building collaborative relationships.
* Detail-oriented with excellent accuracy in data handling and reporting.
* Problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify and implement process improvements.
* Willingness to take the initiative, handle additional responsibilities, and travel as needed.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
* At least 1 Year of prior work experience in Fresh Produce and Fresh Perishable category is mandatory

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PIC (Level 3) certificate
* HACCP Certificate
* ISO 22000, GMP

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- Q Tech General Trading LLC
